Japanese: Hi-νガンダム

The alternate interpretation of the [[nu gundam|nu gundam]] featured in  [[char's counterattack - beltorchika's children|Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack - Beltorchika's Children]].

In addition to a more bulky design, the RX-93-ν2 Hi-Nu Gundam sports an exclusively white and purple (or blue) color scheme to distinguish it from the white and black (or midnight blue) paint job on the RX-93 Nu Gundam. Like the Nu Gundam, the Hi-Nu Gundam also has a mouthpiece with three vents. 

The most prolific difference, however, is its distinct back boosters and revised [[fin funnels|fin funnel]] system. The fairly standard backpack design of the Nu Gundam is replaced with a much more unique dual "long booster" system, with another long booster situated between them and two propellant tanks angled below the dual long boosters. These boosters were capable of great accelerations, and the propellant tanks extended the duration of time the boosters could remain active. The long boosters also served as the storage area for the unit's fin funnels. Also, unlike the Nu Gundam, the Hi-Nu Gundam could recharge the fin funnel's power supply, extending their performance time.

Apart from the obvious visual differences, the Hi-Nu Gundam also expands on the Nu Gundam's armaments, with the addition of a powerful [[machine gun|machine gun]] in its right forearm as well as the inclusion of an extra [[energy sword|beam saber]], bringing the number of beam sabers up to three. The suit can also use a Hyper Mega Bazooka Launcher, an improved model of the weapon used by the [[hyaku shiki|hyaku shiki]] during the [[zeta gundam|Gryps Conflict]], when heavier firepower is required.

Thanks to its [[psycho frame|psycho frame]], a vast improvement over the psycommu system prevalent among mobile suits designed to be used by Newtype pilots, the Hi-Nu Gundam's pilot had much greater control over the mobile suit, piloting it almost as if it were an extension of his own body and bringing out the suit's fullest performance.

It is piloted and designed in-universe by [[amuro ray|amuro ray]]. In real life, it is designed by [[izubuchi yutaka|izubuchi yutaka]].

**Dan Hibiki** (**火引 弾**), known simply as **Dan**, is a character from [[capcom|capcom]]'s [[street fighter|street fighter]] franchise who first debuted in [[street fighter zero (series)|Street Fighter Zero]]. Dan is consistently portrayed as an arrogant, overconfident, yet utterly weak character in many of the games he is featured in. He is widely considered to be the comic relief of the series because of his over-the-top poses and battle cries.

He is originally created as a jab on [[snk|snk]]'s [[ryuuko no ken|ryuuko no ken]] characters [[ryou sakazaki|ryou sakazaki]] and [[robert garcia|robert garcia]], whom Capcom viewed as a rip-off of [[ryu (street fighter)|ryu (street fighter)]] and [[ken masters|Ken]] respectively. Notably featuring numerous taunts from SNK's own fighting game franchise [[the king of fighters|the king of fighters]].

A (self-proclaimed) [[hong kong|hong kong]]er martial artist of Japanese origin. Dan's father, Gou Hibiki, was a rival of [[sagat|sagat]]. Gou gouged out Sagat's right eye and Sagat beat him to death in retaliation. Because of this, Dan sought revenge on Sagat, training to become a fighter, but was expelled from [[gouken|Gouken's]] dojo when his motivations were learned. Dan thus developed his own style of Gouken's martial art merged with Muay Thai elements and called it Saikyo-ryu, "The Strongest Style" ||despite the complete weakness of his techniques.||

Unlike the rest of the Street Fighter cast Dan can taunt while crouching or jumping. He even has a "super taunt" that uses up his entire super meter to perform the greatest and flashiest taunt in the world. The super taunt is so awesome that it gives his opponents great mental distress to the point where they behave erratically and can't focus on the match which allows Dan to go in for the kill and utterly humiliate his opponent. Bonus points for performing the super taunt at the very end of a match. ||It should be noted that this move does absolutely no damage whatsoever and Dan will be completely wide open to any attack due to how long the super taunt is. However it will allow Dan to cancel into his Ultra Combo.||

After it was revealed that all Children of Miare generally live for around 30 years in *Strange Creators of Outer World*, some fans began to count the days until Akyuu's 30th birthday, which would be, according to *Perfect Memento*, around August/September 2024 (earliest August 7, latest September 6). The difference between a highway and a [[street|street]] is that a street is usually inside a [[city|city]] and designed for both vehicle and pedestrian traffic, with [[traffic light|traffic light]]s, [[sidewalk|sidewalk]]s, and [[crosswalk|crosswalk]]s, while a [[highway|highway]] is designed only for vehicles and doesn't have these features. ZUN has confirmed that her hair is indeed naturally gradient. All clothes she is depicted wearing are always criss-crossed. In [[hopeless masquerade|hopeless masquerade]] she is depicted with an [[ajirogasa|ajirogasa]] hat and a [[necklace|necklace]] of [[prayer beads|prayer beads]]. In [[urban legend in limbo|urban legend in limbo]] she gets a [[bikesuit|bikesuit]] along with her own motorcycle.

A 2013-to-present seinen comedy manga by [[sankakuhead|sankakuhead]], with a summer 2015 anime adaptation and fall 2017 season 2 anime by [[doga kobo|doga kobo]]. An alternative version of the manga was serialized for 2 chapters in 2012 before its current serialization.

The term *himouto* (干物妹) in the title is a merger of the term *himono onna* (干物女, "dried fish woman", referring to fish jerky junk food snacks that replace home-cooked meals) and the word *imouto* (妹, "younger sister"). *Himono onna* was coined by the manga [[hotaru no hikari (manga)|Hotaru no Hikari]], and refers to a young woman who leads a stable career but has little to no interest in romance and is generally reclusive, typically at home when not having to go out for her job. Her public and private lives are generally very different, with her public appearance being very clean, organized, and well-mannered. In contrast, her private appearance is messy, disorganized, and ill-mannered.

A [[music|music]] genre and cultural movement originating from [[new york city|new york city]] in the 70s. The subculture encompasses a variety of facets, including music, [[dancing|dance]], [[fashion|fashion]], and [[dj|DJing]]. While it is a primarily American subculture, there are thriving hip hop scenes in other countries, including Japan, Korea, and the United Kingdom. It is predominantly popular in [[urban|urban]] areas.

Elements of hip hop fashion include [[baggy clothes|baggy]] or [[oversized clothes|oversized clothes]], sporty [[sneakers|sneakers]], headwear such as [[baseball cap|baseball cap]]s, [[beanie|beanie]]s, and [[bucket hat|bucket hat]]s, and flashy [[jewelry|jewelry]] such as [[gold chain|gold chain]]s, [[grills|grills]], and large [[wristwatch|wristwatch]]es. [[streetwear|streetwear]] and designer clothing brands are often associated with the style, with some of the most commonly associated brands include [[supreme (brand)|supreme (brand)]], [[a bathing ape|a bathing ape]], [[stussy (brand)|stussy (brand)]], [[nike (company)|nike (company)]], [[air jordan|air jordan]], [[adidas|adidas]], [[gucci|gucci]], and [[louis vuitton (brand)|louis vuitton (brand)]].

This tag should be used for any works that [[parody|parody]] or feature hip hop [[album cover|album cover]]s, [[lyrics|lyrics]], [[audible music|music]] (instrumental or [[audible speech|not]]), fashion, [[real life|real life]] personalities/celebrities, or that include any elements of hip hop culture.

A Japanese dialect spoken in the western parts of [[hiroshima|hiroshima]] Prefecture. Usually considered the stereotypical [[yakuza|yakuza]] dialect.

Heavily features the usage of じゃ (ja) as copula instead of だ (da) in Standard Japanese. Prefers のう (nou) as the sentence-final emphatic particle (instead of Standard Japanese "yo" or "ne"), and shortens から (kara) to け ("ke", often elongated to "kee"). "Jakee" will also pop up in place of the standard "dakara" (this can sometimes be deceptive as it can also have a different nuance).  

Female speakers will often use "uchi" as a first-person 'pronoun'. Male speakers will sometimes use "washi".

"Gaijin" foreigner characters are sometimes also given this accent. The usual justification is almost invariably "this character learned Japanese by watching Yakuza films".

On Danbooru, the Hiroshima dialect is sometimes adapted into a "West Country":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Country_English] accent.

As she is the world's everything and the world is her everything, Histoire can be seen as the goddess of all Gamindustri. Fittingly enough, she has all the world's knowledge and can change it, though not without the power of at least another goddess. Histoire guides [[neptune (neptunia)|Neptune]], [[if (neptunia)|IF]], and [[compa|compa]] throughout Gamindustri during the events of [[choujigen game neptune|choujigen game neptune]] to help her be released from the seal that was placed on her by the main antagonist [[magiquone|magiquone]], enlist the help of the three other goddesses, and save the world from destruction.

In [[choujigen game neptune mk2|choujigen game neptune mk2]], she is the Oracle of Planeptune and watches over the people of that landmass while Neptune, Planeptune's goddess, is still in the Gamindustri Graveyard. By this time, Histoire has apparently saved Planeptune from decline many times, and is seen by the citizens of Planeptune as a great leader.

She and Magiquone were once friends until Gamindustri was split into four.

**Hokuto no Ken** (known as **Fist of the North Star** in the west) is a Japanese [[post-apocalypse|post-apocalyptic]] action manga series and media franchises illustrated by [[hara tetsuo|hara tetsuo]] and written by Buronson. The manga was first published in 1982 on [[weekly shounen jump|weekly shounen jump]].

The original anime adaptation created by [[toei animation|toei animation]] in 1984 sparked a massive controversy due to the anime featured massive amount of violence (especially for its time when "Adult content air time" did not exist), most notably gore. leading to massive usage of censorship on the anime, and the creation of "Adult content air time", a slot of airing time on Television specifically for violent anime.

Nevertheless, the series' extreme violence and masculine-heavy theme had later inspired other action shounen and seinen manga and anime, particularly during late 80s and 90s era. Notable examples were [[jojo no kimyou na bouken|JoJo's Bizarre Adventure]], [[grappler baki|grappler baki]], [[bastard!!|bastard!!]] [[sun-ken rock|sun-ken rock]], [[berserk|berserk]] and recently [[chainsaw man|chainsaw man]] and [[jujutsu kaisen|jujutsu kaisen]].

Due to the unique [[manly|manly]] artstyle, heavely inspired by 80s Movies like [[mad max|mad max]] and [[terminator|terminator]], the show is also frequently subjected to various [[parody|parody]] comedy doujins that were usually revolved around turning various cute anime girl into a "[[hara tetsuo (style)|K-style]]" style macho women (mostly involves the character [[cosplay|cosplay]] and attempt to roleplay as their respective character) for comedic effect.

##### Story (anime adaptation)

Near the end of the 20th century, a nuclear war engulfed most of the Earth's surface, reducing most of the world into a vast desert wasteland. The survivors of mankind banded together in tribes in order to fight over the few supply of uncontaminated food and water still left in the world, with the strong often preying on the weak. [[kenshiro|kenshiro]], the successor of the assassination art known as Hokuto Shinken, wanders the wasteland after being separated from his fiancee [[yuria (hokuto no ken)|yuria (hokuto no ken)]] by his friend-turned-enemy [[shin (hokuto no ken)|Shin]]. Accompanied by two young children, [[bat (hokuto no ken)|bat (hokuto no ken)]] and [[lin (hokuto no ken)|lin (hokuto no ken)]], Ken becomes a savior to the weak and innocent from the various gangs and ruthless bandits threatening their survival. Throughout the course of his journey, Kenshiro encounters various formidable rivals and adversaries, ultimately culminating with Kenshiro's eldest adoptive brother [[raoh (hokuto no ken)|raoh (hokuto no ken)]], an oppressive tyrant who challenges Ken for the right of the Hokuto Shinken succession.

Several years afterward, Kenshiro reunites with the now grown Bat and Lynn in order to stand up against a corrupt Imperial Army. The three, with the help of other rebels, manage to expose a conspiracy within the Imperial Army to keep the Heavenly Empress (||Lynn's estranged twin sister, Lui||) imprisoned. The Empress is saved, only for Lynn to be taken to the "Land of Asura", a country of warriors where only the mightiest survive. Kenshiro crosses to Asura in pursuit of her, only to find himself fighting against the three generals who rule over the land. ||Kenshiro finds himself fighting not only against his own blood brother Hyou, but also [[kaioh (hokuto no ken)|Kaioh]], Raoh's own brother.||

Someone is holding an object.

This tag should only be used for items you can pick up and carry with your hands. Don't use for holding body parts (like [[holding hands|holding hands]], or [[breast hold|holding someone's breasts]]), or for holding clothing being worn (like a [[skirt hold|skirt hold]]), or for holding things with something other than the hands (like a [[mouth hold|mouth hold]], [[holding with feet|holding with feet]], or [[holding with tail|holding with tail]]).

To search for something specific being held, just use two tags together, like this: holding popsicle. Note that these searches don't always work well. Many posts of a search like holding hat are people *wearing hats* while *holding other things*, so it would be ineffective to see people *holding hats*. Hence the existence of specialized tags.

Hololive (stylized as "hololive") is an all-female [[virtual youtuber|virtual youtuber]] group managed by Hololive Production, which itself is owned and operated by Cover Corp.

As of November 2024, the Hololive group consists of 71 currently active VTubers divided across 4 major branches: the 33 members of the original Japanese-speaking branch (unofficially referred to as Hololive Japan), the 10 members of another Japanese-speaking branch [[hololive dev is|hololive dev is]], the 9 members of [[hololive indonesia|hololive indonesia]], and the 19 members of [[hololive english|hololive english]]. (There were also 13 members who have either graduated or been fired, including all 6 members of the now-disbanded [[hololive china|hololive china]].) Each branch is further divided into multiple generations, where each generation is a batch of VTubers who debuted at the same time. Hololive Production also manages the all-male counterpart group [[holostars|holostars]].

In February 2021, Cover announced [[hololive alternative|hololive alternative]], a multimedia project including several manga and music videos that aims to tell in-universe stories using the Hololive VTubers' character backstories. Later, in August 2021, Cover announced [[hololive error|hololive error]], a horror-themed spin-off project. A year later, in June 2022, Cover announced [[holoearth|holoearth]], a game featuring various Hololive members. In March 2023, Cover announced [[blue journey (hololive)|blue journey (hololive)]], a new musical project.

One of [[aesop's fables|aesop's fables]] also known as *The Honest Woodcutter*. In it, a workman dropped his [[axe|axe]] into the [[river|river]] (or a [[lake|lake]] or [[pond|pond]] depending on the variations). The god [[hermes (mythology)|hermes (mythology)]] found out what was wrong, and offered his aid. First Hermes pulled out a silver axe, and asked whether it was the one the workman lost. He told the god that no, it wasn't. Then Hermes pulled out a golden axe, and asked whether it was his. Again, the workman said no. Finally, Hermes pulled out the original axe, and asked if it was his. The workman said that yes it was his. As a reward for his honesty, Hermes gave him all three axes.

Another workman, hearing of this, purposefully drops his axe into the river. He claims it was the golden axe, and ends up not getting any of them, not even his original axe.

This story appears to have become a common part of Japanese culture, with Mercury replaced by a "water sprite" or some such. It is often parodied, including in an episode of [[doraemon|doraemon]] featuring a gadget called the "Woodcutter's Pond" which functions similarly to the fable.

A humanoid youkai (presumably resembling a Han Chinese). She works as the gatekeeper of the [[scarlet devil mansion|scarlet devil mansion]] and specializes in Chinese martial arts. Unusually for a Touhou character, it is unclear what kind of youkai Meiling is, but many fans associate her with [[dragon|dragon]]s. This is in part due to the star on her [[beret|beret]], which bears the Chinese character for "[[dragon|dragon]]" (龍, *Long*). Hong is also the name of a specific dragon from Chinese mythology, implying Meiling has some relation (such as parent and child), or actually is Hong, leading to frequent depictions [[hong meiling (dragon)|as a dragon]]. There are also occasional images that depict her [[hong meiling (panda)|as a panda]].

Fandom also often depicts Meiling as being lazy and ineffective at her job, and often being berated and/or [[knifed|punished]] for this by [[izayoi sakuya|izayoi sakuya]]. In canon, however, her relationship with Sakuya is actually something closer to amicable co-workers, if not outright friendship, and she is generally very good at her job of repelling intruders, with the notable exception of [[kirisame marisa|kirisame marisa]], who everyone else at the mansion admits is impossible to keep out when she wants access to [[voile|voile]].

Sometimes known by her nickname "China" (中国, *Chuugoku*), which originated on [[2channel|2channel]] during a debate about the proper reading of her name's kanji (some believed it to be the Japanese reading "Kurenai Misuzu", and it wasn't until later that [[zun|zun]] revealed that the Chinese reading "Hong Meiling" is correct). Fans came to an agreement that her defining characteristic is being Chinese, and thus called her "China".

A [[money|monetary]] [[gift|gift]] given in Chinese and other Asian societies, usually during holidays (especially [[chinese new year|chinese new year]]) or on special occasions, such as births or weddings.

The Chinese character 福 (fortune) is often found on the front of a hongbao. Other characters that may appear include 囍, 財, 賀 and 春. Occasionally some of these characters can be found upside down as a play on the word "to arrive" (pronounced the same as "upside down"). Characters are almost always written in [[traditional chinese text|Traditional Chinese]] for aesthetic reasons.

Despite the name, the "red envelope" can be found in other colors such as gold (second most common color) or pink. Whites and blacks are avoided as predominant colors though, as these are considered funeral colors.

Mandarin: 紅包 (Traditional) / 红包 (Simplified) (*Hong-Bao*)
Min Nan/Hokkien: 紅包 (*Ang-Pow or Ang-Pao*)
Cantonese: 利事 (*Lai-See*)

Main character from the visual novel [[planetarian|planetarian]] - The Reverie Of A Little Planet.
She goes by the name Reverie Planetarian in the unofficial translation, a name adopted by most fans, which actually refers to the subtitle of the game, rather than the character herself.

She was originally known as Hoshino Yumemi, literally "dreamer  who sees the stars", and was designed by [[komatsu eiji|komatsu eiji]]. Her voice, in CD and PS2 versions, is [[suzuki keiko|suzuki keiko]].

#### Fanbase

A lot of people have fallen in love with Reverie, helped by her, for this time, cheerful and welcoming disposition, as well as a optimistic attitude to everything, which, in a normal situation would be highly welcomed, but, in Planetarian, is actually loathed, since the main character finds her impossible to deal with.

#### Character

In Planetarian, she is the only form of life encountered, beyond the player's character and automated war machines in the entire game, and is hated, early on, for being so oblivious to her lone state.
She also is subject to one of the most tragic fates in the visual novel genre, since, due to the linear nature of Planetarian, which is more like a e-book, there is no way to save her from a tragic ending.

A *[[touken ranbu|touken ranbu]]* character. One of the Awataguchi school swords and thus is one of the many "Toushirou" brothers. 

Has a thing for sweets and married women. Having been owned by Tokugawa Ieyasu, his liking for married women is a reference to Ieyasu's reputation as a womanizer. In fandom, this very quickly snowballed into Houchou either being the only skirt chaser of the citadel, openly lusting after particularly effeminate-looking or wife-like swords (such as [[horikawa kunihiro|horikawa kunihiro]]) if there is an absence of a [[female saniwa (touken ranbu)|female saniwa]] or women in general, or indulging in [[netorare|netorare]]. After a while a lot of fanworks just portrayed him as a needy kid, with the implication that he goes after married women then being due to the fact that they're more likely to give him candy.

He has [[brown hair|brown hair]] and [[brown eyes|brown eyes]]. He wears a [[military uniform|military uniform]] with [[shorts|shorts]] like his brothers, though with a yellow [[necktie|necktie]] instead of a black one. He wears colorful [[japanese armor|Japanese armor]] consisting of [[sode|sode]] and [[kote|kote]] on his right side. He wears a pink [[hairclip|hairclip]] in his hair and carries a [[messenger bag|messenger bag]], which his damaged portrait reveals is full of [[candy|candy]].

**Houseki no Kuni** (宝石の国, lit. "Country of Jewels", English: "Land of the Lustrous") is an ongoing action/fantasy manga series. The series is written and illustrated by Haruko Ichikawa and has been published in Kodansha's *Afternoon* magazine since December 2012.  The manga was on hiatus from December 2020 until June 2022.

Set in a world inhabited by "jewel people," it chronicles their efforts to find the place where they belong and defend their way of life.

An anime promotional video was released on July 2013. A 12 episode anime adaptation aired between October and December 2017.

**Hsien-ko** (*katakana*: **レイレイ**, *hanzi*: **泪泪**) is a video game character from the fighting game series [[darkstalkers|darkstalkers]].

Hsien-ko was born around the 1730s with a twin named Mei-ling. During this time, ghosts and spirits of the dead arose from their resting places and attacked a rural Chinese village.

After their mother was killed by a powerful demon, she and her sister decided to use Tensei-no-Jutsu to save her, but they used a prohibited sub-division of this technique, Igyo Tenshin-no-Jutsu, and fought to release their mother's soul from the dark. This turned the twins into a [[jiangshi|jiangshi]] (僵屍), a type of Chinese vampire. This, however, also gave the two unusual abilities that later makes Hsien-ko capable of wielding a pair of giant [[mechanical arms|mechanical arms]] which the two use to fight for their purposes. [[mei-ling (darkstalkers)|mei-ling (darkstalkers)]] is later transformed into an [[ofuda|ofuda]] on Hsien-ko's hat.

In Japan, the character is known as **Lei Lei**.

Traditional Chinese makeup, which may be located on the [[forehead mark|forehead]], [[mark between eyes|between the eyebrows]], the [[marking on cheek|cheeks]], the temples,  and/or the [[dimple facial mark|dimples]].

Also known as: huazi, mianhua, meizi, Shouyang makeup, and plum blossom makeup.

Huadian were historically worn by women - however, in fantasy depictions based in China, or with Chinese themes, there are depictions of men with similar  or identical markings. This is used sometimes - though not always - as an indicator of supernatural abilites, deity status, or other non-human traits. This may derive from Buddhist influence, with an example being Nezha (哪吒), a male diety from Chinese and Indian mythology, or Erlang Shen, of whom is sometimes depicted with his third eye as a [[forehead mark|forehead mark]].

A genus of [[flower|flower]]ing plants of the *Hydrangeaceae* family, native to southern and eastern Asia. Most species are [[bush|shrubs]], but some are small trees. Commonly called **hortensia**.

Hydrangeas bear globular or umbrella-shaped clusters of flowers that come out any time from early spring to late autumn in a variety of colors influenced by the pH level of the soil. Commonly depicted in shades of blue, purple, and pink.

In Japan, it is commonly associated with the [[rain|rain]]y season. Its Japanese name is "ajisai" (アジサイ or 紫陽花), which refers specifically to *Hydrangea macrophylla*, the bigleaf hydrangea.

Hyouka is the first book of the [[kotenbu series|kotenbu series]], a  novel series by Yonezawa Honobu that was first published in Kadokawa Sneaker Bunko in 2001. It's also the title used for the anime adaptation of [[kotenbu series|kotenbu series]] by [[kyoto animation|kyoto animation]] in 2012.manga illustrated by [[task owner|task owner]].

The story follows a severely unmotivated high school freshman named [[oreki houtarou|oreki houtarou]] who prefers to "conserve energy" as much as possible. When his older sister asks him to join the Classic Literature club to save it from disbandment, he reluctantly agrees. There he meets [[chitanda eru|chitanda eru]], who joins at the same time as him. His longtime friend [[fukube satoshi|fukube satoshi]] and acquaintance [[ibara mayaka|ibara mayaka]] end up joining as well, and together, the group begins to investigate an incident at their school that occurred 44 years ago. Hints of the mystery are buried in an old collection of works previously belonging to the former members of the Classic Literature club. The collection is titled “Hyouka”.

An enigmatic [[pink hair|pink haired]], [[red eyes|red-eyed]] (or [[pink eyes|pink]]) "pilgrim" with her right [[bandaged arm|arm]] wrapped in [[bandages|bandages]] whose search for the "Kappa Arm" led her into the Hakurei Shrine. It is soon revealed that [[amputee|there is no arm inside her bandages]], which are instead filled with a mysterious magical smoke. She wears a [[tabard|tabard]] with a [[red rose|red rose]], a [[short sleeves|short-sleeved]] [[white shirt|white shirt]] and a [[green skirt|green skirt]]. Her appetite for [[baozi|baozi]] also has her frequently depicted with [[large breasts|large breasts]] and/or [[eating|eating]].

Due to the [[shackles|shackle]] on her left arm, her suspicious [[double bun|double bun]]s with [[bun cover|bun cover]]s, and her title implying the existence of horns, there is rampant speculation among fans that Kasen is an [[oni|oni]], specifically [[ibaraki douji (mythology)|ibaraki douji (mythology)]], one of the Big Four. Some of Kasen's actions, such as her avoidance of [[ibuki suika|ibuki suika]], also contribute to the speculation.

She is often accompanied by her pets: [[koutei (touhou)|koutei (touhou)]] the dragon, [[kume (touhou)|kume (touhou)]] the giant eagle, [[kanda (touhou)|kanda (touhou)]] the young eagle, [[mukou (touhou)|mukou (touhou)]] the raijuu, and [[houso (touhou)|houso (touhou)]] the tiger.

Since both characters are hermits, Kasen is often associated with [[kaku seiga|kaku seiga]], though usually on an antagonistic basis since Seiga is a "wicked hermit".

A [[touken ranbu|touken ranbu]] character, designed by [[kanameyura|kanameyura]]. The personification of the [[tachi (weapon)|tachi]] [*Ichigo Hitofuri*](http://meitou.info/index.php/一期一振.) He is the older brother of the Awataguchi school swords, due to the fact that he was the only tachi ever forged by Awataguchi.

Originally named "Okatana Yoshimitsu" (御刀吉光), Ichigo Hitofuri once belonged to Toyotomi Hideyoshi. He ordered the blade to be shortened to match his rather short height. Ichigo Hitofuri was damaged in the summer of 1615 during the Siege of Osaka at Osaka Castle and then re-tempered by Yasutsugu under the order of Tokugawa Ieyasu. However, Ieyasu didn’t had the chance to use this sword because he was advised by the Priest Tenkai to avoid sending Hideyoshi’s swords (including Ichigo Hitofuri) to Edo. It has been an Imperial treasure since that time, alongside [[tsurumaru kuninaga|tsurumaru kuninaga]], [[uguisumaru|uguisumaru]] and [[hirano toushirou|hirano toushirou]].

He has [[short hair|short]] [[aqua hair|aqua hair]] and [[yellow eyes|yellow eyes]]. He wears [[white gloves|white gloves]] and a [[military uniform|military uniform]] with [[necktie|necktie]].

Ichigo has a polite and humble personality and is shown to be concerned with his brothers' well-being. However, it seems that he keeps things to himself, such as the fact that he's worried about losing his identity (since he was retempered in the past) and is secretly displeased about the Saniwa having so many swords. 

Fans enjoy portraying him as the big brother of the Awataguchi tantous, due to him being the biggest/tallest blade among Yoshimitsu's creations, not because he's the oldest among them. Either that, or he's presented as a foil to the prankster Tsurumaru.

Because of his in-game elder brother status, many of the swords tend to call him "Ichi-nii" (Big brother Ichi), which extends to his nickname outside the game as well.

Icing, also called frosting, is a sweet glaze used to coat and decorate baked goods.

While both icing and frosting are commonly used interchangeably, they're also used to refer to similar but slightly different types of glazes for decorating. Frosting can refer to a thicker type of glaze that is better able to hold decorative shapes, while icing can refer to a thinner glaze that hardens and forms a very smooth coating.

A photo of a person's face, straight-on and from the upper shoulders, meant to be used as identification. Commonly seen on passports, licenses, and other official documentation.

In Japan, these photos are known as 証明写真 (*shoumei shashin*) and are taken to put on resumes for job applications in addition to other forms of identification. The typical backdrop for these photos is a solid or gradient [[blue background|blue]]. They can come in sets as in post #6430444, or come individually as in post #6357168.

Idolmaster (アイドルマスター, stylized as *iDOLM@STER *) is a 2005 video game series by [[namco|namco]] (later [[bandai namco|bandai namco]], originally released for the arcade and subsequently for multiple platforms including Xbox 360, PlayStation Portable, Nintendo DS, PS3, PS4, PS5, and PC. The game follows the career of a producer from the 765 Production studio handling ten young [[idol|idols]].

Eventually adapted into mutliple manga, a 2007 mecha re-imagining by [[sunrise (company)|Sunrise]], [[idolmaster xenoglossia|idolmaster xenoglossia]], and a more faithful 2011 anime which precedes the events of [[idolmaster 2|idolmaster 2]]. The series has also spawned three mobile game spinoffs that focus on new groups of idols: [[idolmaster cinderella girls|idolmaster cinderella girls]], [[idolmaster million live!|idolmaster million live!]], and [[idolmaster side-m|idolmaster side-m]]. It has also spawned a HTML5 platform game spinoff, [[idolmaster shiny colors|idolmaster shiny colors]].

An extension of the [[idolmaster|idolmaster]] franchise designed for mobile devices, using the Mobage social gaming platform, in which you may raise and battle your idols against other players.

Cinderella Girls later expanded with rhythm game [[idolmaster cinderella girls starlight stage|idolmaster cinderella girls starlight stage]].

In addition to the original iDOLM@STER girls, the game adds many more new characters, for a total of over 180 idols. These 180+ characters are then divided into three categories, Cool, Cute, and Passion. Cool signifies cool and beautiful types, Cute signifies cute and princess types, and Passion signifies energetic and sexy types.

The game was released November 28, 2011. It ended service on March 30, 2023.

A free-to-play collectible [[card (medium)|card (medium)]] and rhythm mobile game and spin-off of [[idolmaster cinderella girls|idolmaster cinderella girls]].

The game combines much of the existing gacha mechanics of its predecessor with rhythm gameplay and live 3D performances of both [[idolmaster cinderella girls|Cinderella Girls]] songs and new ones original to *Starlight Stage*. In addition to sharing music and characters, many of the same cards appear in the spin-off with expanded and revised illustrations.

Unlike its parent series, the [[producer (idolmaster)|producer (idolmaster)]] works for 346 Production, and the anime original character [[executive mishiro|executive mishiro]] is it's Executive Director.

*Starlight Stage* was co-developed by Cygames and Bandai Namco Entertainment and originally released on September 3rd, 2015 for Android, and on September 10th, 2015 for iOS.

An extension of the *[[idolmaster|iDOLM@STER]]* franchise designed for mobile devices. The original used the GREE social gaming platform, in which players would raise and battle their idols against other players.

In addition to the original *iDOLM@STER* girls, the game adds many more new characters, all designed by A-1 Pictures, which produced the *iDOLM@STER * anime.  These characters are then divided into three categories, Dance, Visual, and Vocal.

In *Million Live!*, these idols are collectively known as the 765 Million Stars, and are presented as effectively being part of 765 Production.  Additionally, unlike *[[idolmaster cinderella girls|iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls]]*, all starting *Million Live!* idols already have seiyuu and a CD.

It received a communication and rhythm game based spinoff, [[idolmaster million live! theater days|idolmaster million live! theater days]], that also introduced two more idols and an assistant.

Bandai Namco Entertainment announced, beginning in December 2017, the original game would be systematically shut down, and service ended March 19 the next year. 
*Theater Days*  continues to receive updates and support as the main game.

In *Theater Days*, they are categorized into Princess (Pink Crown), Fairy (Blue Snowflake), and Angel (Yellow Wing) attributes.

A mobile game spin-off of [[idolmaster|iDOLM@STER]] launched in 2014, this time focusing on producing for the male idols of the 315 Productions agency. 

The members of [[jupiter (idolmaster)|Jupiter]] from [[idolmaster 2|iDOLM@STER 2]]'s 961 Productions are included in the roster, with Akizuki Ryou of [[idolmaster dearly stars|Dearly Stars]]' 876 Productions being added later as part of his own unit.

In March 2015, voices began to be introduced for the idols, starting with the unit DRAMATIC STARS. ST@RTING LINE, a series of music CDs featuring them and other units, also began to be released by Lantis throughout the year. 

In December 2015, a Twitter-based poll called the New Idol Discovery Project (新アイドル発掘オーディション) was run to select three new idols from a pool of nine candidates to form a new unit, with the winners being announced a month later. The winners (Amehiko, Koron, and Sora) were later implemented into the game in July 2016 as the idol group Legenders. The other six candidates have not been put into the game as of late.

In February 2017, Bandai Namco announced the development of [[idolmaster side-m live on stage!|The iDOLM@STER SideM Live on St@ge!]], a mobile spinoff. The game serves as a male counterpart to [[idolmaster cinderella girls starlight stage|Starlight Stage]], as it is a rhythm game utilizing 3D models of the 315 idols for in-game performances. They also announced a *SideM* anime adaptation, with further details being revealed on "315 Day" (March 15). The anime premiered in the fall of 2017.

In 2021, a third game, [[idolmaster side-m growing stars|THE iDOLM@STER SideM GROWING STARS]], was announced following the closure of *LIVE ON ST@GE!*.

Kyoko is a gentle teen who makes a perfect housewife. Her notably nice attitude is often considered to be her most notable trait. Kyoko is sweet and gentle, with the perk of being good at housework. Her hair is usually tied with a ribbon into a [[side ponytail|side ponytail]].

It has been shown in her "The Seven Mysteries of Sacred Slipper Academy" S Rare+, that she can look more menacing than she usually does. Fans say that Kyoko has the possibility of crossing into yandere territory, however it is more likely that she is taking the role seriously.

In the tie in Cinderella Girls Theater skits, Kyoko is a sweet girl who has a joyful disposition. She loves to clean and enjoys remembering her journey as an idol. Kyoko admits that she likes the Producer enough to marry him, and hopes to share an umbrella with him when she’s caught in the rain. Her kindheartedness is displayed when she delivers Christmas presents with her fellow idols to [[sajo yukimi|sajo yukimi]] and how she takes care of the Producer on their day off at the beach. She seems to have trouble drawing cats, as they tend to look more like rabbits, and loves to cook.

Due to her popularity, she was selected for the 9th set of CINDERELLA MASTER CD series, alongside [[ninomiya asuka|ninomiya asuka]], [[ohtsuki yui|ohtsuki yui]], [[nakano yuka|nakano yuka]], and [[aiba yumi|aiba yumi]]. She is voiced by [[tanezaki atsumi|tanezaki atsumi]].

From February of 2008 up to Late November of 2016, Danbooru rewrote select imageboard sources to "Image board" on upload, such as those from 4chan, Cynthia and Yande.re. Due to the nature of things, it is unlikely for those automatic changes to be reversed. (forum #122820)

As a result, post with such sources have automatically received the [[non-web source|non-web source]] tag, due to their now-textual nature.

This tag is for such posts (as well as those posts that were manually desourced from their original by users uploading). If possible, the sources should be standardized for ease of access (forum #152518), if not restored if in any way possible. Posts which have had their sources changed to either their original first-party source, a different text source, or to nothing cannot reasonably be accounted for.

If the source is changed to the image's original first-party source, assuming the source in question is still active, and the md5/EXIF data might not match, please use topic #16765 to get the post replaced. For first-party sources that aren't available anymore ([[bad id|bad id]]), check tools such as SauceNAO and ascii2d, as to see if a link to them can still be obtained (though in such a case, this tag could arguably be retained on the post in question, due to how imageboards can potentially change that data; or if not, substituted with [[md5 mismatch|md5 mismatch]] where appropriate).

#### Example on how to search for such posts
- source:"*Image board*" -source:http*

#### History
The Imperial Japanese Army (IJA) was the army of the Empire of Japan from 1871 to 1945. It was involved in several wars throughout the late 19th and early 20th century, including Russo-Japanese war, both Sino-Japanese wars, and [[world war ii|world war ii]].

The IJA became infamous throughout the world during 30s and 40s due to their countless war crimes and atrocities commited during the [[second sino-japanese war|second sino-japanese war]] and other conflicts in Asia (including but not limited to: cannibalism, large-scale rape, mass-murder, use of chemical and biological weapons, [forced human experimentation on captured civilians](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unit_731) , guerillas, and murder and torture of prisoners of war) committed during this time period (especially during the rule of [[toujou hideki|Hideki Tojo]].) With some even suggest them to be even worse than the [[nazi|nazi]] Germany regime itself.

Following the Japanese surrender, the IJA was dissolved and during 1950s its role as Japan's military's land warfare branch was taken over by the [[japan ground self-defense force|japan ground self-defense force]] which was modeled after the US Army.

#### History

The Imperial Japanese Navy (IJN) was the navy of the Empire of Japan from 1868 to 1945. Following Japan's defeat in [[world war ii|world war ii]], it was replaced with the [[japan maritime self-defense force|japan maritime self-defense force]] (JMSDF). Although the IJN participated in several wars, including the Sino-Japanese War, the suppression of the Boxer Rebellion in China, and a decisive victory in the Russo-Japanese war, it is primarily known for its participation in WWII.

("Eternal Night Vignette from the East")

Ninth game of the [[touhou|touhou]] series, eighth of the mainstream lineup, and fourth of the Windows generation, as well as the third mainstream game in the same generation.

On the eve of the Harvest Moon Festival in [[gensokyo|gensokyo]], youkai sense that the moon has been stolen and replaced with a false one. Someone must freeze time and find the real moon to ensure a full moon on the night of the festival. To this end, a pair of a human and a youkai (4 pairs in total) go in search of the real moon, leading them to a [[yagokoro eirin|genius pharmacist]] and her charge, the [[houraisan kaguya|exiled princess of the Moon]].

The principal faction of [[warhammer 40k|warhammer 40k]], the Imperium of Man was founded by [[emperor of mankind|The God-Emperor of Mankind]] and serves as the government for humanity. It has fallen far from the ideals of scientific enlightenment it was founded upon, instead consumed by intolerance, ignorance, and religious fanaticism following the events of the Horus Heresy and other crises. Its icons are a double-headed eagle known as the Aquila and the skull.

Its armed forces consist of the famous [[adeptus astartes|adeptus astartes]], the Space Marines, and countless, ordinary [[astra militarum|Imperial Guardsmen]], as well as an extensive navy. Internal security is handled by the Inquisition and its associated forces, such as the Officio Assassinorum and the [[adepta sororitas|adepta sororitas]], the Sisters of Battle, as well as the [[adeptus custodes|adeptus custodes]]. In charge of its industry is the [[adeptus mechanicus|Mechanicum]] based on Mars, infamous for their religious reverence of what technology the Imperium has been able to preserve.

Its most famous motto is "The Emperor Protects."

In [[saki (manga)|saki (manga)]] volume 5, out of nowhere [[haramura nodoka|Nodoka]] blurted out: "That reminds me. Apparently it will be possible for people of the same sex to have children through iPS cells."

[iPS cells](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Induced_pluripotent_stem_cell) are stem cells derived from regular cells. They open up many new possibilities in medical treatments, and of course, human cloning.

Due to Nodoka's remark, "iPS cells" became a tag for pictures of a same-sex couple together with their child. And of course it also applies to any character repeating this line as a parody. 

The resulting babies are often referred to as "science babies" or "magic babies".

**Iron Man** is a fictional superhero who appears in comic books published by [[marvel|Marvel Comics]]. The character debuted in *Tales of Suspense* #39 (March 1963), and was created by writer-editor Stan Lee, scripter Larry Lieber, and artists Don Heck and Jack Kirby.

Born [[tony stark|Anthony Edward Stark]], and usually called Tony, he is an industrialist playboy and ingenious engineer who suffers a severe heart injury during a kidnapping in which his captors attempt to force him to build a weapon of mass destruction. He instead creates a powered suit of armor to save his life and escape captivity. He later uses the suit to protect the world as Iron Man. Through his multinational corporation ― Stark Industries ― Tony has created many military weapons, some of which, along with other technological devices of his making, have been integrated into his suit, helping him fight crime.

**Ishuzoku Reviewers** (異種族レビュアーズ, lit. "Interspecies Reviewers") is a manga series written by [[amahara (amahara teikoku)|Amahara]] and illustrated by [[masha|masha]], first published in 2014, about reviewing brothels run by and filled with various girls of varied race. Undead, elves, demons, faeries all judged in their ability to satisfy by an assembly of three fantasy races and a human.

An anime adaptation debuted on January 2020, which became controversial due to its explicit sexual content, most notably [[prostitution|prostitution]]. The anime was banned by mainstream networks in Japan and pulled from Funimation's website after being aired for only 3 episodes. In response, the website *MyAnimeList* was flooded with positive reviews, which temporarily turned the show into the highest rated anime of all time on the site.

Eponymous main character of [[sayonara zetsubou sensei|sayonara zetsubou sensei]].

Nozomu is the homeroom teacher of high school class 2-へ ("2-He", or 2-6/2-F in modern notation). His own name, when compressed, spells out "絶望" - "zetsubou" ("despair") - befitting his extremely negative, suicidal personality. When not attempting suicide, he is normally heard complaining about current issues in Japan and abroad.

A character from [[sayonara zetsubou sensei|sayonara zetsubou sensei]].

Youngest and only female of the Itoshiki siblings and a student of her immediate older brother [[itoshiki nozomu|Nozomu]]. Her own name, compressed, becomes "絶倫" - "zetsurin" ("peerless") - referring to her skill at *ikebana*, but also, much to her ire, a slang related to sexual prowess. The anime adaptation also has her frequently facing her back to the audience, in reference to [[nohara shinnosuke|nohara shinnosuke]], or "Shin-chan", both of which were voiced by [[yajima akiko|yajima akiko]].

A character from [[ichigo mashimaro|ichigo mashimaro]].
Chika is a cheerful girl who shows more common sense than that of her friends. She has brown hair which is often styled into a [[side ponytail|side ponytail]] with [[hair bobbles|hair bobbles]].

Her older sister is [[itou nobue|itou nobue]], who likes to pick on her. She sticks up for her young friends [[sakuragi matsuri|sakuragi matsuri]] and [[ana coppola|ana coppola]], while often disciplining [[matsuoka miu|matsuoka miu]].

The main character of [[fukumoto nobuyuki|fukumoto nobuyuki]]'s gambling manga and anime series [[kaiji|kaiji]] (his family name is rarely mentioned). A young man bouncing between jobs, Kaiji is locked in perpetual poverty and debt. He resorts to gambling to improve his situation, but ends up facing odds he never bargained for. While he is often on the receiving end of punishments, his ability to fight back casts him as the underdog. 

He has a [[pointy nose|pointy nose]], [[sanpaku|sanpaku]], [[long hair|long]] [[black hair|black hair]] with [[medium bangs|medium-length bangs]] and later a [[scar on cheek|scar on his left cheek]] and [[scar on hand|his fingers]]. His outfit changes between the various parts of the story. 

Part 1: An [[open jacket|open]] [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[brown jacket|brown]] [[bomber jacket|bomber jacket]] with four flags on the back: [[american flag|American]], [[south korean flag|South Korean]], [[republic of china flag|Taiwanese]], and [[united nations flag|United Nations]], a [[grey shirt|grey shirt]], [[blue pants|blue pants]], and [[blue footwear|blue]] [[sneakers|sneakers]].

Parts 3 and 4: A [[puffy coat|puffy]] [[black coat|black coat]] and a [[green sweater|green]] [[turtleneck sweater|turtleneck sweater]] with a [[zipper|zipper]].

The protagonist of the [[date a live|date a live]] story. He possesses a strange power that allows him to seal the powers of a Spirit in his body with a kiss.

He has 2 younger sisters: [[itsuka kotori|Kotori Itsuka]] (adoptive sister) and [[takamiya mana|Mana Takamiya]] (biological sister).

Shido has the looks of a handsome young man in high school. He has straight blue hair and bands down to his neck and amber brown eyes. During the times where he borrows another Spirit's power, the color of his eyes turns into a more golden shade with dilated whitened pupils. He is often seen wearing the male [[raizen high school uniform|raizen high school uniform]] during his everyday life circumstances.

During the events of Miku Lily, Shido had to crossdress as a girl to interact with Miku, thereby disguising himself as his alternate identity, [[itsuka shiori|Shiori Itsuka]]. During the time, he was seen with long blue hair, and he wore the standard female Raizen High School uniform. He also wore a flower hair clip as a hair accessory. He is later able to become physically female via Haniel.

A *[[touken ranbu|touken ranbu]]* character, the personification of the historical [[katana|uchigatana]] *Izumi-no-Kami Kanesada*. 
Character designed by [[shiramine (srmn09)|shiramine (srmn09)]], voiced by [[kimura ryouhei|kimura ryouhei]]. 

He was formerly classified by the game as a tachi until July 2015. Both he and [[horikawa kunihiro|horikawa kunihiro]] are personifications of swords that belonged to [[hijikata toshizou|hijikata toshizou]] of the [[shinsengumi|shinsengumi]]. He was asked to be made after the Shinsengumi started to become well known, and Hijikata thus sought after a swordsmith from the Kanesada school, requesting that his new sword be similar to his [[wakizashi|wakizashi]] (Horikawa). This is likely the reason why Izumi-no-kami and Horikawa have the same hair and eye color. He is still around today, located in the Hijikata Toshizou Museum in his hometown of Hino, [[tokyo (city)|tokyo (city)]].

#### Appearance
*See post #1934098 for base form.*

He has [[long hair|long]] [[black hair|black hair]] with part of it done in a [[side braid|side braid]], and [[blue eyes|blue eyes]]. He typically wears [[earrings|earrings]], [[japanese clothes|japanese clothes]], black [[fingerless gloves|fingerless gloves]], and a [[cape|cape]] with the Shinsengumi's distinctive blue and white pattern. For his [[izumi-no-kami kanesada (kiwame)|Kiwame]] form, he puts his hair up in a [[ponytail|ponytail]] and wears a white [[headband|headband]], a Shinsengumi [[haori|haori]] and black [[knee boots|knee boots]]. 

Despite looking like an adult, he is technically the youngest character in the game, being the most recently forged sword as he was made in 1867. Because of this, he often comes across as reckless and a bit overconfident, which is why Horikawa often has to assist him or reign him in. Much of his personality is also inspired by the real-life Hijikata.

A vegetable lantern commonly carved from a [[pumpkin|pumpkin]], typically as a [[halloween|halloween]] decoration. The pumpkin has a face or image carved into it, and the insides are usually scooped out so that a [[candle|candle]] can be placed inside to illuminate the carving.

The practice originated from Ireland where they would use turnips or mangelwurzel to craft these lanterns for Halloween.  Irish immigrants brought this tradition to North America where it led to the development of carving pumpkins to make jack-o'-lanterns.

Jamadhar is a weapon of Indian origin, looking somewhat like a mixture of brass knuckles and a dagger.

Also known as katar or katara. [Japanese Wikipedia article on jamadhar](http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ジャマダハル) states that "the western naming convention of Indian [push daggers](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Push_dagger) as katar, kutar or katara is actually a misapplication of the word, as katar properly refered to a type of double-edged short sword. This misinterpretation arose from the illustrations of the katar and jamadhar being reversed in ['Ain-i-Akbari'](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ain-i-Akbari) a 16th century historical account authored by [Abu'l-Fazl,](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abu%27l-Fazl_ibn_Mubarak) who served Emperor Akbar of the Mughal Empire."

The **Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force** (海上自衛隊, *Kaijou Jieitai*, abbreviated as *Kaiji* or *JMSDF*) is the naval branch of the [[japan self-defense force|japan self-defense force]]. It is the modern successor to the [[imperial japanese navy|imperial japanese navy]], a position it shares with the [[japan coast guard|japan coast guard]].

As it is officially a self-defense force, not a military navy, almost all of the JMSDF's large surface ships are called 護衛艦 (*goei-kan*, lit. "guard ship" or "escort ship") and officially classed as destroyers. However, the term does not include submarines, mine warfare vessels, variants of patrol boat, landing & transport vessels and training ships. The fact that [[js izumo (ddh-183)|Izumo]]-class helicopter carriers with a displacement of nearly 20,000 tons are called "destroyers" is often the butt of jokes.

Unlike the [[japan ground self-defense force|japan ground self-defense force]], which dropped most traditions associated with the [[imperial japanese army|imperial japanese army]], the JMSDF still maintains many traditions of its predecessor, the Imperial Japanese Navy. For example, their tradition of eating [[curry rice|curry rice]] for lunch every weekend was handed down from the IJN.

Representations of the iconic vintage cylindrical Japanese postbox (pillarbox). Since Japan stopped producing cylindrical postboxes in 1970 and has been replacing them with rectangular ones, the older cylindrical design has gained cultural and sentimental value, and a few are being preserved.

The most commonly shown design is the Postal submissions box No. 1 (round) 「郵便差出箱1号（丸型）」, dating from 1949. [Not to be confused with the 1970 submissions box No. 1 (rectangular) 「郵便差出箱1号（角型）」.]
The letter slot is cut into a circular panel on the upper section of the postbox, and is shielded by a curved eave. Collection times are posted on the collection plate, to one side of the circular panel. A square access hatch sits on the lower section of the postbox, below the letter slot. Unlike later, rectangular designs in which mail gets deposited directly into a mailbag that can be removed via a large door, the cylindrical design required loose mail items to be collected by hand through its relatively smaller hatch. This inefficiency led to it being phased out.

This tag is **not** intended for all cylindrical postboxes. Some artistic liberty is allowed, such as variation in size and proportion, or missing/misplaced collection plate or access hatch, but the general design elements must be there. (e.g. post #1109518, despite the [[japanese postal mark|japanese postal mark]] and small access hatch, more closely resembles a UK design in terms of shape and letter slot placement.)

A species of [[bird|bird]].

The head and back of this small perching [[bird|bird]] are olive-green, the throat may be bright yellow, and the belly is pale green or grey. It has a prominent pale white ring around each eye, for which it is named in both English and Japanese.

One of the native species of the Japanese islands, this bird has been depicted in Japanese art on numerous occasions, and historically was kept as a cage bird.

In 2018, molecular DNA evidence convinced scientists to combine this species with that of the warbling white-eye, by which name the Japanese white-eye is now officially known.

A robust rectangular [[container|container]] for fluids such as [[fuel|fuel]] and [[water|water]]. The name refers to its German origins, from the wartime slang "Jerry" for Germans. Recognizable by the cross-shaped indentations on the sides, which improve structural integrity and allow greater surface area for thermal expansion.

The original German design had a 20 liter (approx. 5 gal) capacity and was made from pressed steel. Modern versions are also made in plastic. To prevent contamination (mixing different fuels or mixing fuel with water), color coding or imprinted labels are sometimes used.

Apply this tag only to containers of comparable size and capacity, and bearing the characteristic indentations on the sides. For other (e.g. smaller) containers for gasoline, try [[gas can|gas can]].

Central figure of Christianity, believed to be part of the Holy Trinity ([[yahweh|Father]], Son, and Holy Ghost). Adherents of Christianity believe Jesus was the 'begotten Son of [[yahweh|God]]' who was made incarnate of the [[virgin mary|virgin mary]], became man, [[crucifixion|sacrificed himself on the cross]] to 'cleanse' mankind of its sins, resurrected from the dead after three days, and ascended into Heaven.

Islam, a kindred religion of Abrahamic roots, reveres him as a messenger and as the Messiah, but not as the Son of God. 

Some Mormons (a nontrinitarian restorationist sect) even believe that the ancient [[aztec|aztec]] god [[quetzalcoatl (mythology)|quetzalcoatl (mythology)]] was historically **Jesus Christ**, who visited America in ancient times.

Certain anime and manga series occasionally add their own interpretations of Jesus. One such example closest to [[the bible|the bible]] is [[steel ball run|steel ball run]], but mostly based on Mormon interpretations.

Christ is a title meaning "messiah", not his surname.

When needed specificity he can be refered as "Jesus of Nazareth", named after his hometown.

A fashion subculture for "landmine-type" girls that originated in Japan's "Kabukichō":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kabukich%C5%8D] district and first spread in popularity in early 2020.

Characteristics of this fashion include [[short twintails|short twintails]] or [[two side up|two side up]], [[mouth mask|mouth mask]]s, frilled [[collared shirt|collared shirt]]s, high-waist [[suspender skirt|suspender skirt]]s, [[fishnets|fishnets]], and the overwhelming usage of pink and black. Countless variations exist, but they should all fit the theme described above.

Fashion consists of two sides: 量産型 (ryousangata, literally "mass production") - a more mainstream girly style, and サブカル (subculture) - the more alternative and dark variant. Do note that the latter term is also used for alternative fashion in general.

Known in the west as **JoJo's Bizarre Adventure**. 

An ongoing manga by [[araki hirohiko|araki hirohiko]], and adapted into an anime series by David Production. The series is known for its references to Western music, bizarre [[stand (jojo)|stand (jojo)]] powers, over-the-top scenes which spawned numerous [[meme|meme]]s, and the [[fabulous|glam style]] of the characters and [[jojo pose|poses]].

The anime adaptation is known for its use of written manga-styled [[sound effects|sound effects]] (particularly [[menacing (jojo)|ゴゴゴゴ (menacing)]]), and for using a western classic song as an ending theme, especially the first two parts' ending theme [*Roundabout*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cPCLFtxpadE) by the British progressive rock band [[yes (band)|yes (band)]].

The story chronicles the adventures of the Joestar bloodline, taking place over many "Parts", each starring a protagonist whose nickname is "JoJo".

The Justice League, or Justice League of America (JLA), is a group of superheroes appearing in American comic books published by [[dc comics|dc comics]]. The team first appeared in The Brave and the Bold #28 (March 1960). Writer Gardner Fox conceived the team as a revival of the Justice Society of America, a similar team from DC Comics from the 1940s which had been pulled out of print due to a decline in sales. The Justice League is an all-star ensemble cast of established superhero characters from DC Comics' portfolio. Diegetically, these superheroes usually operate independently but occasionally assemble as a team to tackle especially formidable villains. This is in contrast to certain other superhero teams such as the [[x-men|x-men]], whose characters were created specifically to be part of the team, with the team being central to their identity. The cast of the Justice League usually features a few highly popular characters who have their own solo books, such as [[superman|superman]], [[batman|batman]], and [[wonder woman|wonder woman]], alongside several lesser-known characters who benefit from exposure.

A **kadomatsu** (literally "gate pine") is a traditional Japanese decoration of the [[new year|new year]] placed in pairs in front of homes to welcome ancestral spirits or *kami* of the harvest. They are placed after [[christmas|christmas]] until January 7 (or January 15 during the Edo period) and are considered temporary housing ([*shintai*](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shintai)) for *kami*. Designs for *kadomatsu* vary depending on region but are typically made of [[pine tree|pine]], [[bamboo|bamboo]], and sometimes ume tree sprigs which represent longevity, prosperity and steadfastness, respectively.

The "Traffic Accident of Hell". Stage 4 mid-boss, Stage 5 mid-boss and boss and Stage 6 mid-boss of [[touhou|touhou]]'s *[[subterranean animism|subterranean animism]]*. Also known as "Orin" (お燐) to differentiate her from the earlier, concept-only character [[satsuki rin|satsuki rin]].

A *kasha* (monster cat) responsible for transporting corpses on her [[wheelbarrow|wheelbarrow]] to the Hell of Blazing Fires to regulate its heat. Having learned of [[reiuji utsuho|reiuji utsuho]]'s new power and her naive ambition to conquer the surface world, and fearing punishment from their master [[komeiji satori|komeiji satori]], Rin sent evil spirits above the ground to warn any able fighter to face this threat. Apparent master of the so-called "[[zombie fairy (touhou)|Zombie Fairies]]". Occasionally depicted as a necrophiliac. She appears to have befriended [[chen|chen]] in [[foul detective satori|foul detective satori]], and passed her talent for finding and retrieving dead bodies to her.

Rin's most distinctive feature is that she has two sets of ears, a pair of human-like ears on the sides of her head and a pair of [[cat ears|cat ears]] on the top.

A boy in modern-day Japan desires to be a mastermind who exerts power from the shadows, but in the process of training, gets hit by a truck and dies. He is reborn in a fantasy world as [[cid kagenou|cid kagenou]], where he maintains a perfectly mediocre appearance as to not stand out and pursue his dream of manipulating from the shadows. One day, he stumbles upon an elven girl infected by a mysterious disease and cures her. Cid makes up a story, explaining this world is secretly run by the Cult of Diablos, and his secret organization, "Shadow Garden", are the only ones that can fight them. The elven girl, now named [[alpha (kage no jitsuryokusha ni naritakute!)|alpha (kage no jitsuryokusha ni naritakute!)]], joins this organization and begins recruiting new members. However, the stories Cid made up were actually true, but he believes it to be total delusion. Cid continues fighting the Cult of Diablos under the alias "Shadow", completely unaware that he is involved in a complicated power struggle.

Weekly Shonen Jump manga series created by [[hokazono takeru|hokazono takeru]] in 2023, following the story of [[rokuhira chihiro|rokuhira chihiro]].

Prior to its debut, its first chapter was leaked a week ahead of time. In response to several elements in the chapter itself, as well as the overarching discourse at the time over WSJ's line-up, the manga received an abnormal amount of attention on the online West, ironically labeling it the magazine's new torchbearer in a meme campaign comparable to that of [[morbius (film)|morbius (film)]], which then promptly led many to label it an 'industry plant'. Typical references to the meme include [[kagurabachi pose (meme)|edits and redraws]] of the "key art":[/posts/6707029] released with the manga's debut "announcement":[https://www.oricon.co.jp/news/2294136/full/]. The aftermath of the meme would see appreciation for the manga go from the ironic to the sincere, due to its genuine quality.

**Kaguya Luna** is a [[virtual youtuber|virtual youtuber]] who made her debut on December 9, 2017. She was managed by Vic inc. from the start, but between fall 2018 and fall 2019, she operated under her own autonomous agency, [[the moon studio|the moon studio]]. In addition to her YouTube content, she produced music under the Sony Music label [[sacra music|sacra music]]. She was designed by [[mika pikazo|mika pikazo]].

While neither she nor Vic Inc. have officially announced that she had graduated, her most recent YouTube video was published on August 29th, 2020, and the Kaguya Luna Official channel has been inactive ever since. Kaguya Luna's Twitter account has not been active since October 20th, 2020, and as of the end of 2021, the Kaguya Luna Fan Club website has shut down.

Her voice was often compared to [[hamtaro|hamtaro]], earning her the nickname "Strangled Hamtaro" (首を絞めたハム太郎).

A relatively broad term in Japanese encompassing any fictional human-like character that possesses supernatural abilities (literally meaning "mysterious person"), usually used to refer to villains. Related to [[kaiju|kaiju]], insofar as possessing monstrous traits or abilities, albeit usually human-sized and humanoid in appearance. Examples in Japan include the titular characters from Toho's Transforming Human Series films ([[slime boy|The H-Man]], The Secret of the Telegian and The Human Vapor), [[godman|godman]], and many characters in the [[kamen rider|kamen rider]] franchise (including some of the Riders themselves), while Western examples include [[frankenstein's monster|frankenstein's monster]].

On Danbooru, per the broad definition, kaijin can be depicted in various fashions: [[monster boy|monster boy]]/[[monster girl|monster girl]], [[cyborg|cyborg]], [[alien|alien]], etc. Use the appropriate tag for the specific kaijin.

**Kaiju** (怪獣) is a Japanese word that means "strange beast," but often translated in English as "monster." Specifically, it is used to refer to a genre of tokusatsu entertainment involving giant monsters.

Related terms include kaiju eiga (怪獣映画, monster movie), a film featuring kaiju, kaijin (怪人, humanoid monsters) and daikaiju (大怪獣, giant monster), specifically meaning the larger variety of monsters.

The most famous kaiju is [[godzilla|godzilla]]. Other well-known kaiju include [[mothra|mothra]], [[anguirus|anguirus]], [[rodan|rodan]], [[gamera|gamera]], and [[king ghidorah|king ghidorah]].

She was childhood friends with Otto Apocalypse, who would later become the leader of Schicksal we know today. Her father died when she was still young, killed in a fight against the Honkai. In the world of [[honkai impact 3rd|honkai impact 3rd]], Kallen was one of the descendants of [[kevin kaslana|kevin kaslana]] of the Previous Era.

Since then, Kallen was dedicated to protecting people from the Honkai. This raised [[otto apocalypse|Otto]]'s fears, as he feared she would die the same way as her father.

When they grew to adults, they were betrothed, as both Kallen and Otto came from two of the influential families in Schicksal, the Kaslana family (the 'Knight') and the Apocalypse family (the 'Bishop'). Such a marriage would unite the two families. While Otto Apocalypse harboured romantic feelings for Kallen, Kallen did not reciprocate.

Within the storyline [[yae sakura|yae sakura]] and herself existed 500 years in the past with Yae rescuing Kallen after the latter washed ashore on the riverbanks of the Yae village where they developed an intimate relationship with one another.

Otto's obsession with Kallen led to an attempt to clone Kallen, eventually creating a girl he adopted as his grandaughter, [[theresa apocalypse|theresa apocalypse]].

Voiced by [[mizuki nana|mizuki nana]] with a positive, and stoic personality.

She also has a pair of optical goggles around her neck for use in various situations.
- [[kallen kaslana (sixth serenade)|Sixth Serenade]] - Kallen takes up the guise of shadows to fight against the false light of the Church. Sporting a purple-themed jacket, skirt, and side cut pants allowing her to be extremely fast on the battlefield.

Main character from [[kimetsu no yaiba|kimetsu no yaiba]].
He is a Demon Slayer in the Demon Slayer Corps, who joined to find a remedy to turn his sister,  [[kamado nezuko|kamado nezuko]], back into a human and to hunt down and kill demons, and later swore to defeat [[kibutsuji muzan|kibutsuji muzan]], the King of Demons, in order to prevent others from suffering the same fate as him.

Before he became a Demon Slayer, Tanjiro was a coal burner before his entire family was slaughtered by Muzan while his younger sister, Nezuko, was turned into a demon.

He has ruffled, [[black hair|black hair]] with burgundy tips, combed back to expose his forehead, and wide, dark [[red eyes|red eyes]] with [[white pupils|white pupils]] that appear lighter around the lower section of his irises.

Tanjiro first appears wearing a checkered, black and sea foam green [[haori|haori]] over a white robe and black pants. He occasionally sports a [[turquoise scarf|turquoise scarf]] and is seen with circular, [[white bands|white bands]] looped around his calves. He also wears a distinct pair of [[hanafuda earrings|hanafuda earrings]], with the image of the rising sun over a mountain.

During the Final Selection, Tanjiro wears a blue, cloud-patterned samue-styled [[kimono|kimono]] and [[black pants|black pants]], nearly identical to Sakonji's outfit. He still wears his [[hanafuda earrings|hanafuda earrings]], but his hair is cut extremely short and remains the same length since. Similar to the rest of the apprentices that were trained under Sakonji, Tanjiro wears a hand-carved [[fox mask|fox mask]] crafted from his master on the left side of his head. The mask has red accents on the eyes, ears, and spots on each corner of its mouth. On the upper right corner of the mask, there is a sun-shaped design that likely symbolizes the scar on his forehead.

After becoming a Demon Slayer, Tanjiro wears the standard [[demon slayer uniform|demon slayer uniform]], a dark-brown gakuran jacket, a white belt, baggy chocho zubon pants that extend into tabi socks, a pair of zōri with red straps, and bands of white cloth wrapped tightly around his calves resembling kyahan, all beneath his signature [[checkered haori|checkered haori]]. He carries a large [[wooden box|wooden box]] on his back (which was a gift to him from [[urokodaki sakonji|urokodaki sakonji]]), where his sister sleeps as they travel during the day.

||After being turned into a [[demon|demon]] by [[kibutsuji muzan|kibutsuji muzan]], Tanjiro is able to heal the growth on his face as well as regenerate his lost arm and other smaller injuries. He obtains eyes with [[slit pupils|slit pupils]], fangs and flame-shaped marks over his left forehead and right jaw that are reminiscent of those of [[kokushibou|kokushibou]], in addition to a third, smaller flame-shaped mark coming down from the right side of his head down to his eyebrow after he conquered the weakness to sunlight. His scar turns into a flame-pattern as if it were a permanent Demon Slayer Mark, has become longer and is the largest of the three, and all three marks vaguely point towards his nose, though only his scar-mark reaches it. He still dons his bloodstained corps uniform, one sleeve ripped off where his arm was severed, but loses his checkered haori and the Nichirin Sword at his hip.||

||After returning to his human form, Tanjiro loses the ability to see from his right eye, the iris of which is now a dull pink-gray color and the pupil black rather than its original white. His left arm, which he regrew as a [[demon|demon]], now takes the appearance of that which an older person may have, becoming wrinkled and skeletal, and he loses all feeling in it below the elbow and thus the ability to move it from his forearm down.||

**Kamen Rider** (仮面ライダー), also known as Masked Rider, is a Japanese [[tokusatsu|tokusatsu]] franchise created by Shotaro Ishinomori.

The plot generally involves at least one main character who possesses the ability to transform and does battle with monsters and organizations that are somehow related to his origin.

Riders are typically identified by their insect-like features such as their compound eyes and antenna. Other visual cues include intricate belts, motorcycles, [[henshin|henshin]] poses, scarves, and the signature finisher, the Rider Kick.
