Shikishi 色紙 (しきし) is a particular format of paperboard for art, [[calligraphy|calligraphy]], [[poem|poetry]] and [[signature|autographs]]. Recognizable by its squarish dimensions, it also has characteristic edges which are often evident in posts that are [[photo (medium)|photo (medium)]]s of [[traditional media|traditional media]] pieces.

As it is popularly used by artists drawing sketches to give away at conventions (e.g. pool #1135), the term is sometimes used to describe such drawings as well. These are often autographed, dated and/or inscribed with the name of the convention (and artist's booth number). [[marker (medium)|Marker]] is a common medium for these.

*Sanseido Daijirin* gives two dimensions for shikishi: 19.4×17 cm and 18.2×16 cm. Some pixiv taggers will use 「小色紙」 ("small shikishi") for the smaller size. Variants may be colored, have pre-printed elements, or may even have gold or silver leaf embedded in the paper. Fancy [[novelty shikishi|novelty]] types are sometimes used; these may come in a different shape (post #1952713) or expose a differently shaped drawing area instead of the full card (e.g. post #523719). 

Not to be confused with irogami 色紙 (いろがみ), colored paper commonly used for crafts and origami.

For some 'shikishi' present in drawn images, use [[shikishi (object)|shikishi (object)]].

Shimohara Sadako (下原定子?) is a Witch of the [[502nd joint fighter wing|502nd joint fighter wing]], originating from [[fuso (strike witches)|fuso (strike witches)]] and affiliated with the Fuso Imperial Navy. Her familiar is the Japanese hare.

Warm, nurturing, and tirelessly helpful around the barracks, Shimohara acts as something of a mother figure in the 502nd, although her fondness for cute things (which includes some of her squadmates) and propensity for hugging has led to a "creepy old man" aspect of some portrayals.

She is both a talented and passionate cook, especially with regards to Fuso cuisine, for which Flying Officer [[kanno naoe|Kanno]] is especially grateful, although its led to a fondness for Fuso cuisine amongst the entire squad. Her specialties are nikujaga and miso soup and she tries to get supplies from Fuso to prepare them whenever there is an opportunity to. Also due having once set her sights on literature, she cherishes the Fuso culture and attempts to propagate it in the 502nd Joint Fighter Wing whenever she can.

Shimohara is based on Japanese flying ace Uehara Sadao (上原定夫).

Shn Megami Tensei: Nocturne (真・女神転生III-NOCTURNE, lit. "True Goddess Reincarnation III-NOCTURNE) is the third game in the [[shin megami tensei|shin megami tensei]] series. Know as "Shin Megami Tensei: Lucifer's Call" in PAL regions.

In the story, the world comes to an end during an event called the "Conception", whose purpose is to destroy the old world in order to create a new one. The few survivors each possess a 'Reason', an idea of how the new world should be like. The main character, the [[demi-fiend|demi-fiend]], must then choose which Reason he will support, achieving different endings for the story depending on which one is chosen.

A Director's Cut version of the game was released, named "Shin Megami Tensei: Nocturne Maniax", and featured an additional dungeon, bosses and [[dante (devil may cry)|Dante]] from the [[devil may cry (series)|devil may cry (series)]] series as a recruitable character. It was this version that was localized into english and released outside of Japan.

Another version of the game, called "Shin Megami Tensei: Nocturne Chronicles" was released alongside a limited edition of [[devil summoner (series)|devil summoner (series)]]: Raidou Kuzunoha vs. King Abbadon, where [[kuzunoha raidou|kuzunoha raidou]] replaced Dante as the special recruitable character.

Because it literally has the meaning of "Can I be in your bosom?", it is sometimes jokingly referred to as a sexually suggestive phrase.

After his Kiwame remodel, ||he isn't recognized by his former masters, but gets to reunite with the Sakai clan again. **Shingeki no Kyojin** (also known as **Attack on Titan**) is a manga by [[isayama hajime|isayama hajime]].

In an alternative past, humanity has been attacked by monstrous giants called [[titan (shingeki no kyojin)|Titans]]. What remains of it has barricaded itself behind a 3-walled fortress-country, and any attempt at war against the Titans has ended with disastrous results. The Titans, however, were unable to breach the walls, and so humanity has lived in safety for a century. One day, 2 unusual Titans appear out of nowhere and destroy the gate of the outer wall. In the ensuing massacre, Eren Yeager sees his mother devoured before his eyes. Swearing to eradicate all Titans, he enlists in the army alongside his adopted sister Mikasa Ackerman and friend Armin Arlert.

Nominated for the 4th Manga Taishou Awards (2011) and winner of the 35th annual Kodansha Manga Award for Best Shounen, Nominated for the 16th Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize (2012).

A Japanese death god, one who reaps souls.

After [[world war i|world war i]], the European image of [[death (entity)|death (entity)]] found its way into Japan, and most modern depictions of shinigami are at least slightly influenced by European folklore. Unlike the European Death, shinigami are commonly depicted as a species of death spirits rather than a single personification of the concept of death.

Despite her simple, adorable looks, Fubuki is prone to uploading random shitposts (usually "vocal" covers of popular songs or memes), and loves cracking jokes. Some examples including her insistance that she's the viewer's "friend" after being occasionally "proposed" to by them, her cover of "Scatman's World", the "YA BE" macro meme, and the (in)famous "glasses are really versatile" copypasta.

On November 5th, 2020, Fubuki became the third member of Hololive (after [[gawr gura|gawr gura]] and [[inugami korone|inugami korone]]) to reach 1 million subscribers on Youtube.

A Japanese female [[ninja|ninja]] from [[fatal fury|fatal fury]] and later [[the king of fighters|the king of fighters]]. She debuted in *Fatal Fury 2*.

Her trademarks are her [[folding fan|folding fan]], and her [[revealing clothes|revealing clothes]] that show off her [[large breasts|large breasts]] and other notable features. She has [[brown eyes|brown eyes]] and most commonly wears her [[long hair|long]], [[brown hair|brown hair]] in a [[ponytail|ponytail]] tied up with an ornamental hairpin.

Mai is the last heir to Shiranui-ryuu Ninjutsu. She can infuse her attacks with [[fire|fire]], since fire ninja magic is a hallmark of the Shiranui Ninja clan. She has a loving infatuation with fellow Shiranui-ryuu practitioner [[andy bogard|andy bogard]], whom she trained with at a relatively young age and she came to see as a good man (though she tends to move the relationship a little too quickly for Andy's liking). As of [[garou: mark of the wolves|garou: mark of the wolves]], she and Andy both train a young disciple named [[hokutomaru|hokutomaru]]. She is good friends with most of the rest of the Fatal Fury roster, not least of which includes Andy's brother [[terry bogard|Terry]] and best friend [[joe higashi|joe higashi]]. In King of Fighters, she is a founding member of the Women Fighters Team alongside [[king (snk)|king (snk)]] and [[yuri sakazaki|yuri sakazaki]], with other ladies such as [[toudou kasumi|toudou kasumi]] joining the team here and there.

Mai is one of [[snk|snk]]'s most popular characters, appearing in numerous cross-overs and promotions. Her oldest and arguably greatest cross-company rival is [[capcom|capcom]]'s [[street fighter|street fighter]]'s [[chun-li|chun-li]]. She also appears in [[dead or alive|dead or alive]] (*DOA 5 Last Round* and *DOA 6*) as a guest character and has been announced as an upcoming guest character in [[street fighter 6|street fighter 6]], the second ever guest character (after Terry) to appear in a mainline Street Fighter title.

Due to her revealing attire, she was denied a cameo in [[super smash bros.|Super Smash Bros. Ultimate]] since she would be challenging the game's [[cero|cero]] rating of A. The way Sakurai put it in the announcement ("[[smash is for good boys and girls|smash is for good boys and girls]]") was turned into a meme. She received a new outfit with her appearance in [[fatal fury: city of the wolves|fatal fury: city of the wolves]].

A *[[touken ranbu|touken ranbu]]* character.

A [[tachi (weapon)|Tachi]]. His name literally means "Candlestick-cutter Mitsutada", referring to an incident where his namesake was used to kill someone and happened to cut through a bronze candlestick as well. He is obsessed with being cool, even saying it would have been cooler if he had cut through a candlestick made from a sturdier material. He is noted to [[look-alike|resemble]] [[kantai collection|kantai collection]]'s [[tenryuu (kancolle)|Tenryuu]] with his [[eyepatch|eyepatch]], general appearance and mannerisms. His black clothes reference the fact that his sword's current appearance is burnt to the hilt.

His original sword is one of  [[date masamune|date masamune]]'s blades, along with [[ookurikara|ookurikara]], [[tsurumaru kuninaga|tsurumaru kuninaga]], and [[taikogane sadamune|taikogane sadamune]].  Mitsutada seems to hold the latter in fond regards, since he calls him "Sada-chan" and specifically asked around for him in his citadel quote, leading artists to portray the two in a pseudo-familial relationship. He has nicknames for the rest of Masamune's blades, calling Tsurumaru "Tsuru-san" and Ookurikara "Kara-chan".

He has a generally friendly personality, and is seen as the heart of the Masamune group due to his compassion. When he interacts with [[sayo samonji|sayo samonji]] or [[taikogane sadamune|taikogane sadamune]], he takes on a more brotherly or [[fatherly|fatherly]] disposition. He also seems to enjoy cooking (a reference to his former master Date Masamune, who also liked to cook), since he's able to actively help out his new masters.  For this reason, some artists portray him as a secondary butler like [[heshikiri hasebe|heshikiri hasebe]].

Fans have given him the nickname "Candle-Cutter [[pikachu|pikachu]]" (CCP), based on an alternate reading of the kanji for Mitsutada.

Appears in *[[touken ranbu: hanamaru|touken ranbu: hanamaru]]* as a recurring side character.

**Shouji** (障子) are a type of [[door|door]], [[window|window]], or room divider in traditional [[east asian architecture|Japanese architecture]]. They consist of thin, translucent paper on a wooden lattice frame. The paper is thin enough to let light in, but not to see through.

Shouji can be used as [[sliding doors|sliding doors]] or as windows. Sometimes, shouji panels may include a small glass window to see through.

Shouji are similar to [[fusuma|fusuma]], another type of sliding paper panel. The difference is that [[fusuma|fusuma]] are made of thick, opaque paper that doesn't let light through.

Its first season lasted 12 episodes and was broadcasted from April 11, 2014 until June 27, 2014 in Japan. A second season was broadcast on the same dates in 2015.

The localized anime series is currently available for streaming exclusively on Netflix in all its territories.

A *[[honkai impact 3rd|honkai impact 3rd]]* and *[[benghuai xueyuan|Benghuai Xueyuan]]* character. The second Herrscher after [[welt joyce|welt joyce]], and dominated the power of the void. She became a Herrscher and started the Second Impact in 2000 at a Schicksal laboratory and has pulled the whole North Siberia into her void realm. Rumours say that she was inhumanely experimented on and tortured by the tests and therefore awakened the Herrscher consciousness inside of her and took the girl's mind.

Sirin perished together with S-rank Valkyrja [[cecilia schariac|cecilia schariac]] and four other A-rank Valkyries (Squad Snow Wolf) in a series of nuclear explosions caused by a rain of missiles from Schicksal.

After Sirin's death, her Herrscher core got been divided into five parts, those being the main Core of Void itself and the 4 extra Authorities granted to her, those being the Gem of Conquest (Thunder), Gem of Desire (Wind), Gem of Haste (Fire), and Gem of Serenity (Death). The four different Gems are kept separately by Schicksal and Anti-Entropy, while the Void Core was secretly obtained by Otto while everyone else was unaware of its existance.

In the current game era (Honkai Impact 3rd) [[otto apocalypse|otto apocalypse]] created [[kiana kaslana|K-423]] (a clone of Kiana Kaslana mixed with Sirin's DNA) using the techniques he used for his adopted granddaughter [[theresa apocalypse|theresa apocalypse]], and inserted the Void Core into the empty clone, succesfully giving it life and Sirin a new body.

Sirin's soul/consciousness within the core then split into two: the side that wanted a happy life as Cecilia's daughter (K-423 Kiana), and the side that wanted revenge on the world ([[kiana kaslana (herrscher of the void)|Void Kiana]]).

Thus was Sirin the Herrscher of the Void resurrected/reincarnated, just as Otto secretly planned. The Void's power doesn't normally show up, but in some special conditions, her power would burst dealing a large scale of destruction. The mysterious sound in Kiana's (K-423) head is actually Void Kiana's, her other self, but she doesn't have a clue.

She is named after the Russian mythological creature of the same name which is usually depicted as a beautiful half-woman, half-bird.

In version 5.0, an ELF form of her was released. In version 6.9, [[sirin (miracle magical girl)|Miracle Magical Girl]], a Magical Girl version of Sirin from a bubble world, became playable as a Mecha/Fire battlesuit.

The **Škorpion vz. 61** is a [[czech republic|Czechoslovak]] compact [[submachine gun|submachine gun]] designed in the early 1960s, initially chambered in .32 ACP (7.65×17mmSR Browning), while later variants are available in 9mm Makarov, 9mm Parabellum and .380 ACP. It features a wire [[folding stock|top-folding stock]] and uses a standard 10/20-round magazine. 

The Škorpion was originally intended (an served mostly) as a compact sidearm for [[tank|tank]] crews and other vehicle crews. Even today, it is in active service in the Czech [[military|military]] (now issued mainly to guards) and in elite [[police|police]] squads.

It could also be the result of a [[prank|prank]] or [[bullying|bullying]].  If one sleeve is tied to the other, instead use [[sleeves tied together|sleeves tied together]].

A [[shirt|shirt]], [[dress|dress]], or other top with a neck but without sleeves, often revealing [[bare arms|bare arms]].

On Pixiv, the tag [アメリカンスリーブ](http://dic.pixiv.net/a/%E3%82%A2%E3%83%A1%E3%83%AA%E3%82%AB%E3%83%B3%E3%82%B9%E3%83%AA%E3%83%BC%E3%83%96) (American Sleeve) is used to denote a kind of sleeveless clothing where the armholes are cut near the base of the neck to the lower armpit, leaving a large portion of the shoulders bare. This is also typically a [[sleeveless turtleneck|sleeveless turtleneck]].

This tag may be used for tops with [[detached sleeves|detached sleeves]], but not for [[strapless|strapless]], [[halterneck|halterneck]], [[off-shoulder shirt|off-shoulder]], or [[spaghetti strap|spaghetti strap]] tops. See the differences below.

A [[dress|dress]] with [[sleeveless|no (attached) sleeves]].

Sleeveless dress can be used together with [[detached sleeves|detached sleeves]], since sleeveless dress only refers to the torso garment, and do not take detached sleeves into account.

Do not confuse this tag as a "catch-all" tag for all dresses that simply leave the shoulders [[bare shoulders|bare]].
- If the dress has a *low and wide-cut neckline* and has *attached* sleeves that sit on the arms instead of on the shoulders, it is an [[off-shoulder dress|off-shoulder dress]].
- If the dress has no attached sleeves and has no support of the shoulders (ie. [[halterneck|halterneck]]s, shoulder straps, etc.) to keep it in place, it is a [[strapless dress|strapless dress]].

Sleeveless dresses, [[strapless dress|strapless dress]]es, and [[off-shoulder dress|off-shoulder dress]]es are mutually exclusive to each other.

A light novel and webnovel series authored by Morita Kisetsu and illustrated by [[benio (dontsugel)|benio]]. In English, the title is "I've unknowingly become max level after defeating slimes for 300 years."

> ※２０１７年４月１５日ＧＡノベルさん２巻発売します！ 皆さんのおかげです！
> ごく普通の社畜ＯＬ、相沢梓は働きすぎが原因で過労死した。
> そのため、１７歳の容姿を持つ不老不死の魔女として、高原の一軒家でスローライフを送ることにした。
> 主な収入源は近くに生息するスライムを倒して魔法石を手に入れること。これをふもとの村のギルドで売っていた。ほかにも、薬草の知識を使って薬を作ってあげたりして、「高原の魔女」として感謝され、敬意を集めて生きていた。
> 
> だが、３００年もスライムを倒す生活を続けてきた結果、経験値が蓄積しすぎて、知らないうちにレベル９９の世界最強の魔女となっていたことが発覚。
> 
> レベル９９の魔女は今日も村のみんなのため、世の中のために、弟子のドラゴン少女とともにほどほどに働きます。

Translation:

> [[aizawa azusa|aizawa azusa]], a very ordinary office lady, died due to overwork.
> 
> For that reason, she decided to live a leisurely life in an isolated home near a plateau as an immortal witch with the appearance of a 17 year old.
> 
> Her main source of income is defeating slimes and acquiring their magic stones. She sells these stones at the guild of the village near the base of the mountain. Besides that, she also makes medicine from her knowledge of medicinal herbs. She came to be known as "The Witch of the Plateau" (高原の魔女) for the honor and gratitude she has been given for her efforts.
> 
> However, as a result of continuing life defeating slimes for 300 years, she accumulated too much experience and before she knew it, it came to light she was the world's strongest witch at Level 99.
> 
> A story about a Level 99 witch working together with her dragon girl disciple for the sake of everyone in the village, and for the world.

**SNK**, an acronym of **Shin Nihon Kikaku** (新日本企画, lit. "New [[japan|japan]] Project"), is a legendary [[video game|video game]] company, most notable for its powerful [[neo geo|neo geo]] console from the 90s as well as various fighting games (like [[the king of fighters|the king of fighters]]), and [[arcade|arcade]] shooters like [[metal slug|metal slug]]. Its main rival is [[capcom|capcom]].

SNK's predecessor **Shin Nihon Kikaku Corporation** was founded in 1978 by Kawasaki Eikichi. In 1981, the name was informally shortened to SNK Corporation, which became the company's official name in 1986.

SNK merged with Playmore in 2003 after going bankrupt in 2001 to form **SNK Playmore**. The company eventually changed its name back to **SNK** in 2016.

An astronomical event where the moon passes between the sun and the earth, and the moon partially or completely covers the sun as viewed from a location on earth. This can only happen during a new moon, when the sun and moon are in conjunction as seen from earth.

A solar eclipse can be one of two major kinds: a partial eclipse, where the moon partially blocks out the sun; and a total eclipse, where the moon blocks out the sun completely and the sun's light creates a spectacular white ring around the moon.

Solar eclipses are frequently used in fiction to mark important, and often catastrophic, events in the plot.

It received a sequel in [[2001|2001]], [[sonic adventure 2|sonic adventure 2]], marking the 10th anniversary of the Sonic the Hedgehog series. In [[2003|2003]], it received an enhanced port for the [[gamecube|Nintendo Gamecube]] and [[pc|pc]] titled **Sonic Adventure DX: Director's Cut**.

One of the most iconic and instantly recognizable figures of pop culture in entertainment. Starring in several cartoons and anime, movies, a hit video game series, and holds the record for the longest running comic book series based from a [[video game|video game]] franchise. 

The main hero of the [[sonic (series)|sonic (series)]] franchise, **Sonic the Hedgehog** is a blue-colored hedgehog who can run at extremely fast speeds, and has a upbeat personality with a smarty-pants attitude while always looking forward to adventures. He loves chili dogs and rock music. He makes friends easily, but will equally not forgive anyone who threatens his friends and the world. His long-time nemesis is [[dr. eggman|dr. eggman]], but they seem to uphold their rivalry on decent terms. Sonic can also change his form state, by collecting all 7 of the [[chaos emerald|chaos emerald]]s and harnessing their positive energy to transform into Super Sonic; which bears a striking resemblance to a [[super saiyan|super saiyan]] from the [[dragon ball z|dragon ball z]] universe. This in turn grants him exponential speed and power increases, among flight abilities also making him immune to most attacks. 

Sonic was designed and created by Japanese artist and game designer [Oshima Naoto](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naoto_%C5%8Cshima.) He was initially codenamed "Mr. Needlemouse" during development as Sega's new mascot and was originally colored teal. His trademark blue pigmentation was chosen later to match Sega's cobalt blue logo. [Uekawa Yuji](http://sonic.wikia.com/wiki/Yuji_Uekawa) provided the revamping of Sonic The Hedgehog's art style with the shift to the 3D era with the [[sonic adventure|sonic adventure]] games around 1998.

Sonic replaced [[alex kidd (character)|Alex Kidd]] as the official mascot of [[sega|sega]] Corporation since 1991.

Voiced by Kanemaru Jun'ichi in Japan, and Jaleel White, Martin Burke, Ryan Drummond, Jason Griffith, and Roger Craig Smith in North America.

Sophitia is a benevolent, faithful, selfless, and strong-willed young woman who is devoted to her family and will do anything to protect them by all means, even if it means sacrificing her own life. She was sent on a holy quest by Hephaestus, Greek god of the Forge, to destroy [[soul edge (weapon|Soul Edge]]. The affair soon affected her other family members as well, including her sister, [[cassandra alexandra|Cassandra]], and later her children, [[pyrrha alexandra|Pyrrha]] and [[patroklos alexander|Patroklos]]. 

Sophitia has pale skin and [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair|blonde hair]] that is usually tied in a [[braid|braid]]. She looks like a greek heroine, most of her attire consists of a [[dress|dress]] matched with [[shoulder pads|shoulder pads]] and [[vambraces|vambraces]]. She is usually depicted wielding a short [[sword|sword]] and a round [[shield|shield]].

Anything related to the former Soviet Union, and, to a wider extent, the Warsaw Pact.

The **Soviet Union** (1917-1991), officially the **Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR)**, was a vast [[communism|communist]] federated state in what is today [[russia|russia]] and other adjacent nations with a state ideology of [[karl marx|Marxism]]-[[vladimir lenin|Leninism]]. The Warsaw Pact was a collective defense treaty created in response to the expansion NATO, led largely in the foreign policy interests of the Soviet Union, including the remaining communist states in Europe of the era, sans [[yugoslavia|yugoslavia]] and, later, Albania, with key world allies such as Marxist-Leninist [[cuba|cuba]], although the tag should not apply to states that did not constitute the Soviet Union.

This tag can refer to a) Soviet-related iconography, such as the [[hammer and sickle|hammer and sickle]], [[red star|red star]], Soviet-stylized [[cyrillic|cyrillic]], [[russian text|Russian]], or other text; or b) posts that either show a location within the Soviet Union during the period of its existence, or are indicated as being of the general era when the Soviet Union or Warsaw Pact existed (based on architecture, attire, technology, etc.), in which case the post would be tagged with this tag and the respective country tag (if one applies), e.g., like *soviet russia* or *soviet ukraine*.

The **Workers' and Peasants' Red Army**, or more known by their shortened name Red Army, was the prime land warfare forces of the [[soviet|Union of Soviet Socialist Republic]]. It was established in 1917 and was in service until 1946 when the army took the official name of "Soviet Army", It was then in service until its dissolution in 1991 following the dissolution of the Soviet Union. A momentary bright shimmer of reflected [[light|light]], generally [[diamond (shape)|diamond (shape)]]- or [[star (symbol)|star (symbol)]]-shaped, and short-lived. Groups of them tend to appear and vanish in various instances.

**Sparkle**, [[glint|glint]], and [[diffraction spikes|diffraction spikes]] all refer to similar patterns of bright lines radiating from a point. They are not clearly differentiated, and usage tends to be context-sensitive. In general:
- **Sparkle** is considered the base case. Usually four lines at right angles radiating from a point. Associated with eyes, liquid or particulate matter (e.g. raindrops, snow, sand), or nothing (appearing mid-air). Can appear in large numbers.
- [[glint|glint]] is associated with solid objects, especially ones which are metallic and/or sharp. Usually appear singly or in small numbers.
- [[diffraction spikes|diffraction spikes]] is the technical term for the phenomenon in general, but is used less often. Can be used for more realistic-looking effects or conversely when appearing extremely large and exaggerated. More likely than sparkle and glint to be asymmetric or to have more than four radiating lines.

A poisonous [[flower|flower]] (species *Lycoris radiata*) commonly associated with death. 

A spider lily has 4-6 flowers growing from a central leafless stem, forming a sort of dome. Natural colors include red (most common), pink, [[white spider lily|white]] and [[yellow spider lily|yellow]], sometimes depicted in non-existent black and [[blue spider lily|blue]]. The most noticeable features are the long stamens, which give it a distinct entangled/spidery look, earning its common English name 'Spider Lily'. 

Its Japanese name is "*Higan-bana*" ([*Higan*](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Higan) flower) or "*Manjushage*". It blooms without leaves and bears leaves without flowers, which is why it is also known in Japan as 葉見ず花見ず (*ha-mizu, hana-mizu*), roughly translated as "without seeing leaves, without seeing flowers".

Not to be confused with [[chrysanthemum|chrysanthemum]], some species of which have long and thin outer petals that can resemble spider lily stamens.

**Spider-Man** is a fictional [[marvel|Marvel Comics]] superhero. The character was created by writer-editor [[stan lee|stan lee]] and writer-artist Steve Ditko. He first appeared in *Amazing Fantasy* #15 (Aug. 1962).

[[peter parker|peter parker]] was orphaned at the age of six when his parents were killed in an airplane crash overseas. He went to live with his uncle and aunt; Ben and May Parker, in Forest Hills, [[new york city|new york city]]. Parker was extremely bright and became a high honors student at Midtown High School. Parker's shyness and scholastic interest often made him a social outcast. 

While attending a public exhibition demonstrating the safe handling of nuclear laboratory waste materials sponsored by the General Techtronics Corporation, Peter was bitten by a spider which had been irradiated by a particle accelerator used in the demonstration. Making his way home afterwards, Peter discovered he had somehow gained incredible strength, agility, and the ability to cling to walls; spider-like traits that he immediately associated with the spider bite. 

In the 1970s, he was given his own [[tokusatsu|tokusatsu]] [[spider-man (toei)|series]] in Japan where he had a [[mecha|mecha]] ([[leopardon|leopardon]]).

On [[nijiura|nijiura]], he shares a flat with [[astaroth (shinrabanshou)|astaroth (shinrabanshou)]], [[we-tan|we-tan]], and [[yamada-san|yamada-san]].

A 2018 animated film in [[marvel|marvel]]'s [[spider-man (series)|Spider-Man]] series, loosely based on the Spider-Verse event from the comics. As in the source material, the film follows a story in which spider heroes from multiple different universes are brought together to stop an interdimensional threat. It notably uses a variety of art and animation styles to highlight the differences in the worlds each hero comes from. The movie is also notable for being [[miles morales|miles morales]]' first film appearance.

The movie was a massive success, winning the Academy, Annie, and Golden Globe Awards for Best Animated Feature, and creating a wave of interest in a live-action adaptation of the Spider-Verse comic.

A sequel titled *[[spider-man: across the spider-verse|spider-man: across the spider-verse]]* is set to release in June 2023, and a spin-off film focused around female spider heroes titled *Spider-Women* is planned to release in the future. Several TV series spin-offs based on the characters are currently in production as well.

Third installment of *[[splatoon (series)|splatoon (series)]]*, released in 2022 for the [[nintendo switch|nintendo switch]].

The game launched with four gameplay modes, those being: **Turf War**, a multiplayer mode playing similar to Regular Battles in previous games; **Anarchy Battle**, a multiplayer mode playing similar to Ranked Battles in [[splatoon 2|splatoon 2]] with a group of rotating game styles; [[salmon run (splatoon)|Salmon Run: Next Wave]], an updated version of the co-op mode introduced in Splatoon 2; and **Return of the Mammalians**, a single-player campaign focusing on the new [[squidbeak splatoon|squidbeak splatoon]] member **[[agent 3 (splatoon 3)|agent 3 (splatoon 3)]]** as they deal with the onset of Fuzzy Ooze, a substance that bestows mammalian traits onto creatures that touch it. After launch, a fifth mode was added as DLC making up "Wave 2" of the Expansion Pass, **[[splatoon 3: side order|Side Order]]**, a single-player campaign focusing on **[[agent 8 (splatoon)|agent 8 (splatoon)]]**, returning from [[splatoon 2: octo expansion|Octo Expansion]], as they take on a mysterious tower called the Spire of Order.

Other features include [[splashtag (splatoon)|splashtag (splatoon)]]s and customizable lockers.

**Sport utility vehicle** (SUV) is a [[car|car]] classification that has off-road features, such as four-wheel drive and higher ground clearance. SUVs are generally built on light truck chassis and have bulkier dimensions compared to regular cars.

As consumer tastes have evolved to prefer SUVs to standard cars, less rugged takes on the platform have emerged, including SUV-like vehicles based on car chassis, known as **CUV**s or "Crossovers." For danbooru purposes, these types of vehicles are included under this tag.

***Star Trek*** is a legendary American [[science fiction|science fiction]] entertainment franchise. 

The original Star Trek is a classic American [[science fiction|science fiction]] TV series, created by Gene Roddenberry, which debuted in 1966 and ran for three seasons, following the interstellar adventures of Captain [[james tiberius kirk|james tiberius kirk]] and the crew of the Federation Starship [[uss enterprise|uss enterprise]], following an earlier pilot film “The Cage,” which starred Jeffrey Hunter as Captain Christopher Pike. 

Following the release of other series in the franchise, the Kirk-headed series was retroactively referred to as "[[star trek: the original series|star trek: the original series]]".  

These adventures were continued by the short-lived Star Trek: The Animated Series and six feature films.

The original series were influential in both the west and the east. In Japan it inspired the famous [[uchuu senkan yamato|uchuu senkan yamato]] classic anime series. 

Four more television series were eventually produced, based in the same universe but following other characters: [[star trek: the next generation|star trek: the next generation]], following the crew of a new Starship Enterprise set a century after the original series; [[star trek: deep space nine|star trek: deep space nine]] and [[star trek: voyager|star trek: voyager]], set contemporaneously with The Next Generation; and Star Trek: Enterprise, set before the original series, in the early days of human interstellar travel. 

Four additional feature films were produced, following the crew of The Next Generation, and most recently a 2009 movie reboot of the franchise featuring the young crew of the original Enterprise set in an   [[star trek: kelvin timeline|alternate time line]]. 

The newest Star Trek television revival, beginning in 2017, includes the series [[star trek: discovery|star trek: discovery]], [[star trek: picard|Picard]], Short Treks, [[star trek: lower decks|Lower Decks]], Prodigy, and [[star trek: strange new worlds|Strange New Worlds]], streaming on digital platforms.

The franchise also includes dozens of computer and video games, hundreds of novels, as well as a themed attraction in Las Vegas (closed in September 2008). Beginning with the original television series and continuing with the subsequent films and series, the franchise has created a cult phenomenon and has spawned many pop culture references.

***Star Wars*** is an epic American space opera franchise initially conceived by filmmaker [[lucasfilm|George Lucas]]. The Star Wars series tells a [[science fiction|science fiction]] and [[fantasy|fantasy]] story set in a fictional universe. The saga began officially with the release of the [[star wars: a new hope|first film]] in the series during May 1977 (although a novel adaptation by Alan Dean Foster was released several months before in late 1976), the original film was followed by two sequels; [[star wars: the empire strikes back|The Empire Strikes Back]] in 1980 and [[star wars: return of the jedi|Return of the Jedi]] in 1983, which concludes the original film trilogy.

Because of its huge success across the world during the late 70s, several Japanese anime and manga from that era were heavily inspired by it.

One of the most recognizable weapons in the Star Wars universe, is a fictional type of sword that has a beam of light for a blade: the [[lightsaber|lightsaber]].

An official [[star wars manga|star wars manga]] adaptation of these films was released in 1998.

A "prequel trilogy" of films (set chronologically before the plot of the "original trilogy") were released in 1999, 2002 and 2005.
The trilogy consists of [[star wars: the phantom menace|The Phantom Menace]], [[star wars: attack of the clones|Attack of the Clones]] and [[star wars: revenge of the sith|Revenge of the Sith]].

After the series rights were sold by Lucas to the [[disney|Walt Disney company]], a new "sequel trilogy" of films for the series was announced in 2012. This trilogy officially began with the release of the [[star wars: the force awakens|star wars: the force awakens]] film in 2015 and continued with [[star wars: the last jedi|star wars: the last jedi]] in 2017 and [[star wars: the rise of skywalker|star wars: the rise of skywalker]] in 2019.

Several animated series related to the main saga were also released. Among them [[star wars: clone wars|star wars: clone wars]] for [[cartoon network|cartoon network]] in 2003, [[star wars: the clone wars|star wars: the clone wars]] in 2008, [[star wars: rebels|star wars: rebels]] in 2014 and [[star wars: resistance|star wars: resistance]] in 2018.  

Two spin-off "Star Wars Anthology" films were released between each sequel film. The first Anthology film is called [[rogue one: a star wars story|rogue one: a star wars story]] and is set in the period of the Galactic Civil War of the original films. This new film premiered in late 2016. A film focusing on Han Solo called [[solo: a star wars story|solo: a star wars story]] was released in 2018.

A live action net series called [[the mandalorian|the mandalorian]] and a video game called [[star wars jedi: fallen order|star wars jedi: fallen order]] were also released in late 2019.

Star Wars is one of the highest-grossing media franchises of all time.

**Return of The Jedi** is the third installment in the original [[star wars|star wars]] film trilogy, the third film to be produced, and the sixth chronological order. The film was released in theaters on May 25, 1983. It grossed $374 million worldwide during its initial theatrical run, becoming the highest-grossing film of 1983. 

The film stars [[mark hamill|mark hamill]], [[harrison ford|harrison ford]], [[carrie fisher|carrie fisher]], Billy Dee Williams, Anthony Daniels, David Prowse, Kenny Baker, Peter Mayhew and Frank Oz.

[[luke skywalker|luke skywalker]] and friends travel to [[tatooine|tatooine]] to rescue their companion [[han solo|han solo]] from the vile [[jabba the hutt|jabba the hutt]]. The Empire prepares to crush the Rebellion with a more powerful [[death star|death star]], while the Rebel fleet mounts a massive attack on the space station. Luke confronts his father, [[darth vader|darth vader]], in a final climactic duel before the evil [[palpatine|Emperor]].

16 years after the release of Return of the Jedi, [[george lucas|george lucas]] wrote and directed the prequel trilogy, consisting of the films [[star wars: the phantom menace|The Phantom Menace]], [[star wars: attack of the clones|Attack of the Clones]] and [[star wars: revenge of the sith|Revenge of the Sith]].

[[star wars|star wars]]: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith is a 2005 American epic space opera film written and directed by [[george lucas|george lucas]]. It stars [[ewan mcgregor|ewan mcgregor]], [[natalie portman|natalie portman]], [[hayden christensen|hayden christensen]], Ian McDiarmid, [[samuel l. jackson|samuel l. jackson]], [[christopher lee|christopher lee]], Anthony Daniels, Kenny Baker and Frank Oz. The sequel to [[star wars: the phantom menace|star wars: the phantom menace]] (1999) and [[star wars: attack of the clones|star wars: attack of the clones]] (2002), it is the sixth film in the Star Wars film series and the final installment in the Star Wars prequel trilogy.

Revenge of the Sith is set three years after the onset of the [[star wars:  the clone wars|Clone Wars]] as established in Attack of the Clones. The [[jedi|jedi]] are spread across the galaxy in a full-scale war against the Separatists. The Jedi Council dispatches Jedi Master [[obi-wan kenobi|obi-wan kenobi]] on a mission to defeat [[general grievous|general grievous]], the head of the Separatist army and Count Dooku's former apprentice, to put an end to the war. Meanwhile, after having visions of his wife [[padme amidala|padme amidala]] dying in childbirth, Jedi Knight [[anakin skywalker|anakin skywalker]] is tasked by the Council to spy on [[palpatine|palpatine]], the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic and, secretly, the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious. ||Sidious manipulates Anakin into turning to the dark side of the Force and becoming his apprentice, [[darth vader|darth vader]], with wide-ranging consequences for the galaxy.||

***Star Wars: The Clone Wars*** is an American [[3d|3d]] CGI animated television series created by George Lucas and produced by Lucasfilm Animation, Lucasfilm and CGCG Inc., released in 2008. 

This [[science fiction|science fiction]] and fantasy series began with a theatrical feature film that was released on August 15, 2008, and debuted on Cartoon Network two months later on October 3, 2008.

The show is set in the fictional [[star wars|star wars]] galaxy during the three years between the prequel films [[star wars: attack of the clones|Episode II: Attack of the Clones]] and [[star wars: revenge of the sith|Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]. It follows the course of the titular conflict through the lens of various characters as they deal with the war's impact upon them.

The Clone Wars was a massive ratings success, becoming one of [[cartoon network|Cartoon Network's]] highest rated shows during its initial run. Throughout its run, the series received mostly positive reception from critics, receiving praise for its writing, action, characters, visuals, voice acting, music, scale and tone. 

The series has also garnered a massive fan following and has also been nominated for many USA entertainment industry awards, including the Daytime Emmy Awards and the Annie Awards. 

Not to be confused with the 2003 series, [[star wars: clone wars|star wars: clone wars]], which was 2D animated and was declared as non-canon after Disney acquired the franchise.

When a character's limbs or body is held in place by objects or devices that are made of rigid materials and locked into position such that they will not budge or sway if the victim struggles.

Key examples are [[pillory|pillories]] or [[stocks|stocks]] mounted in place, shackles bolted or screwed to a surface, (such as a wall, floor, or table) cuffs holding the subject inside a [[sex machine|sex machine]], and pipe arrangements built around the subject.
Restraints that are tethered by ropes or chains do not count, nor do tentacles. (be they organic or metallic)

The victim may have some freedom of movement or be bound by ropes or chains in addition, but at least one restraint must convey a sense of being made of solid materials and mounted firmly enough not to easily move or sway in response to the captive's struggling.

In some cases the restraints themselves may be able to move, such as a machine capable of posing the victim, but should appear the restrained subject does not have any influence upon the restraints.

The **Statue of Liberty** (*Liberty Enlightening the World*, French: *La Liberté éclairant le monde*) is a colossal neoclassical [[statue|statue]] on Liberty Island in [[new york city|new york city]] Harbor.

The statue, a gift to the [[united states|United States]] from the people of [[france|france]], is of a robed female figure representing Libertas, the Roman goddess of freedom, who bears a torch and a tabula ansata (a tablet evoking the law) upon which is inscribed the date of the American Declaration of Independence. A broken chain lies at her feet. The statue has become an iconic symbol of freedom and of the United States.

The statue was designed by Frédéric Bartholdi and dedicated on October 28, 1886. It stands 93 meters high and weighs 204 metric tonnes. Inside the statue is a staircase that allows visitors to climb from the pedestal all the way up to the crown above her head.

A [[bra|bra]] without straps, relying on an extra-wide band for breast support. 

They are designed to be worn with [[strapless|strapless]] clothing that would otherwise expose the bra straps. They achieve their strength through a longer underwire that encompasses more of the breast, and cups with added padding, boning, and shaping panels. Some have rubberized or silicone beading inside the top edge of the cup to help keep the bra attached to the breast. Some convertible bras allow the straps to be removed, making them into strapless bras.

Don't confuse [[strapless bra|strapless bra]]s with [[tube top|tube top]]s or [[bandeau|bandeau]]s. A strapless bra has cups, while tube tops and bandeaus don't.

"藁人形 (*wara-ningyou*, straw dolls)" are Japanese-style [[voodoo doll|voodoo doll]]s.
They are usually made of a few bundles of straw, and are used in a traditional Japanese curse ritual known as "丑の刻参り (*Ushi no Koku Mairi*)." This ritual is frequently translated into English as "Midnight Anathema Ritual." Every night, the ritual takes place during "Ushi no Koku," the name of a time period used in traditional Japan, representing 1:00 to 3:00 in the morning. The person who executes the curse wears white clothing , paints face powder on his/her face, puts a trivet on his/her head , stands candles on that trivet, wears [[tengu-geta|single-toothed]] *[[geta|geta]]*, and at a sacred tree growing in a *[[shinto|shinto]]* [[shrine|shrine]], selects a *wara-ningyou* for a person he/she detests, and nails a *gosun-kugi* (a large [[nail (hardware)|nail (hardware)]] about 5 inches in length) to the doll. The first person to do this kind of curse in Japan was a very jealous woman who was called "the Bridge Princess of *Uji*." But the procedure she used in her ritual is a little different from the "Ushi no Koku Mairi" ritual that has been passed down to today. You may have heard the words "*wara-ningyou*" and "*gosun-kugi*" in the intro to "魔理沙は大変なものを盗んでいきました([[marisa stole the precious thing|marisa stole the precious thing]])."

A paved [[road|road]] in a [[city|city]] environment, usually designed for both vehicle and pedestrian traffic.

The difference between a road and a street is that [[road|road]] is for all types of roads, including [[highway|highway]]s and [[dirt road|dirt road]]s outside of cities, while a street generally refers to a paved road in a city. A street is usually designed to accommodate both vehicle and pedestrian traffic, with intersections, [[traffic light|traffic light]]s, [[sidewalk|sidewalk]]s, and [[crosswalk|crosswalk]]s. A [[highway|highway]] is usually designed only for high-speed or long distance vehicle traffic and doesn't have these features.

A street can be unpaved dirt, but is most often paved with a hard, durable surface such as asphalt, concrete, cobblestone or brick.

**Strider Hiryuu** (ストライダー飛竜) is a [[science fiction|science fiction]] character jointly owned by [[capcom|capcom]] and the *Moto Kikaku* [[comic|comic]] studio.

Although primarily known as a [[video game|video game]] character, Hiryuu debuted in 1988 as the protagonist of a manga published exclusively in [[japan|japan]] by Kadokawa Shoten. 

He made his first video game appearance in the 1989 coin-operated machine [[strider (video game)|Strider]], which was followed by the release of a [[nes|nes]] game based on the japanese manga released exclusively in North America during the same year. 

Since his debut, Hiryuu (飛竜 "Hiryuu" usually interpreted to mean "Flying Dragon") has appeared in various video games produced by Capcom.

In most versions of the Strider story, Hiryuu is an elite-class member of a group of futuristic, high-tech [[ninja|ninja]] known as the "Striders", who specialize in various kinds of wetworks such as espionage, sabotage, and assassinations. Hiryuu is the youngest Strider ever to earn an "A" class rank, what makes him a formidable warrior in any type of battle. His signature weapon is the "Cypher", a [[plasma sword|plasma sword]] with a [[tonfa|tonfa]]-like handle able to cut through anything.

**Strike Witches** (ストライクウィッチーズ) is a light novel and anime series set in an alternate [[world war ii|world war ii]] setting in which the nations of the world band together to defend against an alien invasion. Their only trump cards are witches (genderswapped versions of real life World War II fighter pilots) who don engine-shaped leggings known as [[striker unit|striker unit]]s to fly and do battle in the sky. 

The series later spawned several sequel and spin-off, which were later collectively named the [[world witches series|world witches series]].

*Written by [[yamaguchi noboru|yamaguchi noboru]]
*Illustrated by [[shimada fumikane|shimada fumikane]], [[ueda hashigo|ueda hashigo]]

The red string of fate (*unmei no akai ito*, 運命の赤い糸) is an East Asian belief that every person in the world is connected to another by an invisible red string tied to little finger of the left hand. The two people connected by the red string are destined to be lovers.

It is similar to the Western concept of soulmates. The concept is popularly referenced in anime and manga. Notable examples include [[ai yori aoshi|ai yori aoshi]] and [[kimagure orange road|kimagure orange road]], which frequently reference this concept.

Usually the game doesn't end until at least one player has lost enough times to be [[completely nude|completely]] [[nude|nude]].

Sometimes the game starts out this way, but it can also be the result of a [[gambling|gambling]] game where one particularly unlucky player loses all their money and, in a desperate attempt to retake some of it, starts literally betting the clothes off their back.

Specific games commonly played under these circumstances include [[strip poker|poker]], [[strip mahjong|mahjong]] and even [[rock paper scissors|rock paper scissors]].

Not to be confused with a [[twitter strip game (meme)|twitter strip game (meme)]] where the game is played by the audience via votes.

Studio Ghibli is an iconic Japanese animation studio that has produced many successful films over the years.

Founded by [[miyazaki hayao|miyazaki hayao]], [[suzuki toshio|suzuki toshio]], [[takahata isao|takahata isao]] (1935-2018), and [[tokuma yasuyoshi|tokuma yasuyoshi]] (1921-2000), this core group of collaborators has overseen the direction and production of much of the studio's creative output. Other notable staff include [[anno hideaki|anno hideaki]], [[kousaka kitarou|kousaka kitarou]], [[andou masashi|andou masashi]], [[yamashita akihiko|yamashita akihiko]], [[futaki makiko|futaki makiko]] (1958-2016), and [[yoshida ken'ichi|yoshida ken'ichi]].

The **Sturmgeschütz III** (**StuG III**) assault gun was Germany's most produced armored fighting vehicle during [[world war ii|world war ii]]. It was built on the chassis of the proven [[panzer iii|panzer iii]]. Initially intended as a mobile, armored light gun for infantry support, the StuG was continually modified and was widely employed as a tank destroyer.

When the [[sturmgeschutz iv|Sturmgeschütz IV]] entered production in late 1943 and early 1944, the "III" was added to the name to separate it from the [[panzer iv|panzer iv]]-based assault guns. All previous and following models were thereafter known as Sturmgeschütz III.

A **submachine gun** or SMG is a carbine-length, pistol-caliber [[gun|firearm]] that is capable of fully automatic fire. Early SMGs such as the [[mp18|mp18]] have rifle-like appearance. While more modern models do have features like [[folding stock|folding stock]], pistol grip and a fire selector. The term "submachine gun" was coined by [[thompson submachine gun|John T. Thompson]], to describe its design concept as an automatic [[weapon|weapon]] with notably less firepower than a [[machine gun|machine gun]] (hence the prefix "sub-"). 

A subset of submachine gun is dubbed **machine pistol**, which are often used to describe a handgun with automatic fire capability (e.g. Glock 18C), or compact SMGs with [[handgun|handgun]]-like ergonomics (e.g. Micro Uzi).

A submersible marine vessel. More often then not, they are also [[military vehicle|military vehicles]].

A boss-type submarine enemy in [[kantai collection|kantai collection]], introduced in the Fall 2015 event, which focuses on the "Solomon Island Campaign":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solomon_Islands_campaign].

Like many "princess-tier" [[abyssal ship|abyssal ship]], she has voluminous [[very long hair|extremely long hair]] and wears a flowing white [[dress|dress]]. To her right is a large metal structure shaped like the bow of a WW2-era submarine, except with a trademark [[teeth|toothy]] maw and glowing eyes.  She holds or swims near multiple [[torpedo|torpedo]]es. A pair of tubes also seem to connect into the back of her thighs or butt.

Unlike most of the "princess" or "oni" characters, there doesn't seem to be an obvious single historical reference that Submarine Princess represents, instead seeming to embody all submarines. She has, however, been considered "*Albacore* Princess" by some, due to the USS *Albacore*'s notorious record against the IJN, although *Albacore* spent the Solomon Campaign sinking transports, and wouldn't get most of the kills that made the ship notorious until afterwards. There has also been the suggestion that she is "I-27":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japanese_submarine_I-27], an unimplemented Type-B1 submarine (the same class as [[i-19 (kancolle)|Iku/I-19]]) who sank in the area where she is encountered as a boss.

A passenger transport system in an urban area with a high capacity and frequency, and grade separation from other traffic. A native flowering plant from the Americas.  The common sunflower is most recognizable by their single large yellow apical "flower," with an initially greenish center that turns yellow-brown and then blackish as it matures.  They typically grow to heights of around 3 meters (10 feet) with record plants reach heights of 9+ meters (30+ feet). Sunflowers are grown for various purposes such as for food, cooking oil, livestock feed, and decoration. 

Domestic sunflowers come in a variety of colors beyond the common yellow, with colors such as cream color, gold, orange, red, mahogany, and chocolate brown.  While the common types only feature a singular apical flower (one that grows at the tip of the central stem), there are also varieties that grow many additional branching flowers.  The large blooms of the sunflower while commonly called a "flower" is in fact a "flower head," a structure composed of many smaller flowers (florets) that together appear as one single flower.

Sunflowers and their relatives are heliotropic while they're developing, meaning that the plants will turn following the direction of the sun during the day.  As they get closer to maturing, the plant stiffen and lose it's ability to track the sun. Due to their heliotropic nature, most plants will mature locked facing toward the East, the direction of the rising sun.

The Suomi KP/-31 (*Suomi Konepistooli 31*, or "Finland machine pistol 31") was a [[submachine gun|submachine gun]] used by Finland in [[world war ii|world war ii]], and exported in small numbers to several other nations.

It was designed by Aimo Lahti from 1921 to 1931, produced from 1931 to 1953, and remained in service until 1998. The weapon is most commonly pictured with a [[drum magazine|drum magazine]], which held 71 rounds of 9x19mm ammunition, but numerous other magazines were also used: a 20-round box, a highly unsuccessful 40-round drum, a 50-round quadruple-stack "Coffin" box, and post-WW2, a highly reliable Swedish 36-round box. The 71-round drum magazine inspired the very similar magazine of the Soviet [[ppsh-41|ppsh-41]].

A powerup in [[new super mario bros. u deluxe|new super mario bros. u deluxe]] that transforms [[toadette|toadette]] into [[peachette|peachette]], a [[princess peach|princess peach]] lookalike retaining some original form attributes, with Peach's abilities and more. Canonically, the game's official website states only she can use it.

Fans, however, used it to similarly transform [[bowser|bowser]], and from there on [[king boo|king boo]], then many more characters, and even [[personification|personify]] items, from the [[mario (series)|Mario universe]]. More specifically in human female, but no additional abilities. The more esoteric the subject, the less “lookalike” or even “human” applies.

The trend is known as “peachifying” (ピーチ姫化) in Japan. The result is typically named with either an "-ette" suffix (in reference to Peachette), or by default a “princess” title like Peach ("-Hime" suffix in Japanese).

- Tag [[transformation|transformation]] only if the change is shown or suggested. (post #3262233).
- Tag [[genderswap|genderswap]] only if the change is shown or suggested, or the expected result is swapped. (post #3265315)
- Copyright tag with [[new super mario bros. u deluxe|new super mario bros. u deluxe]], not the origin of the character's regular form.

There are two classes of [[racecar|racecar]] in Super GT, GT500 and GT300. The GT500 class is comprised of manufacturer supported teams from [[toyota|toyota]], [[nissan|nissan]], and [[honda|honda]] with purpose-built racecars loosely based on production vehicles featuring performance rivaling non-hybrid Le Mans Prototypes and largely equivalent to the Class 1 cars from [[deutsche tourenwagen masters|DTM]]. GT300 is a more mixed class, featuring FIA GT3 spec vehicles from foreign manufacturers alongside Super GT's own JAF-GT spec vehicles.

Super GT is notable for being one of the few remaining major motorsport series to feature [[race queen|race queen]]s.

**Super Robot** (スーパーロボット *Sūpā Robotto*) is an old genre of anime focused on giant [[robot|robot]] [[mecha|mecha]] with various super powers, special and flashy weapons, and the cliche of attack/special move naming.

It originated from [[tetsujin 28-gou|tetsujin 28-gou]] from the [[1950s (style)|1950s (style)]]/[[1960s (style)|1960s (style)]] and the [[mazinger z|mazinger z]] series created by [[nagai gou|nagai gou]] in the early [[1970s (style)|1970s (style)]]. While not as popular as it was during its beginnings, it still continues to this day.

It evolved into the more realistic **[Real Robot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mecha_anime_and_manga#Real_robot) **(リアルロボット *Riaru Robotto*) anime genre started by [[tomino yoshiyuki|tomino yoshiyuki]]'s [[mobile suit gundam|mobile suit gundam]] in the late [[1970s (style)|70s]] and early [[1980s (style)|80s]]. This genre also continues to this day.

[[super robot wars og saga mugen no frontier exceed|Super Robot  Wars OG Saga: Endless Frontier Exceed]] is a sequel to the SRW OG spin off game [[super robot wars og saga mugen no frontier|Super Robot Wars OG Saga: Endless Frontier]].

Introduces two new characters: 

- [[neige hausen|neige hausen]] - Brown haired female
- [[aledy naash|aledy naash]] - Red haired male

d:
A subseries of [[super robot wars|super robot wars]] that combines the original characters, [[mecha|mecha]], and plot elements from the crossover games into new titles featuring only Banpresto originals. Original characters and units from other Banpresto crossover games appear in the series as well.

The first game in the series was released on [[game boy advance|game boy advance]] in 2002 and featured two playable routes, one following [[ryuusei date|ryuusei date]] as the main protagonist and the other following [[kyousuke nanbu|kyousuke nanbu]]. OG1 and [[super robot wars original generation 2|super robot wars original generation 2]] were remade into a single game in **Super Robot Wars Original Generations**, which was released for [[playstation 2|playstation 2]] in 2007.

OG1 introduces the original elements from the following entries:
- The 2nd SRW
- Hero Chronicles: Project Olympus
- The 3rd SRW
- The 4th SRW
- Super Hero Operations
- [[super robot wars alpha 1|super robot wars alpha 1]]
- Super Robot Wars Compact 2 - Part 1
- Super Robot Wars Compact 2 - Part 2

d:
A [[super robot wars|super robot wars]] mobile game launched in 2015. Due to it's nature as a gacha game, it constantly added new series for events and promotions, and quickly amassed the largest roster in the franchise. Character designs for the game's new original characters are provided by [[watanabe wataru (character designer)|watanabe wataru (character designer)]].

Following a sudden announcement on the official Twitter page, the game was shut down on March 30, 2021.

d:
A trilogy of games in the [[super robot wars|super robot wars]] series, particularly notable for featuring the debut appearances of many of the most popular [[mecha|mecha]] series of the 2000s.

#### Entries
- [[super robot wars z1|super robot wars z1]]
- [[super robot wars z2|super robot wars z2]]
- [[super robot wars z3|super robot wars z3]]

A powered version of [[sailor chibi moon|sailor chibi moon]], prominently seen in the anime's fourth story arc when [[helios (sailor moon)|helios (sailor moon)]] grants her and [[sailor moon|sailor moon]] his power to become stronger. Chibi Moon uses the Crystal Carillon to summon Pegasus with the spell Twinkle Yell. She has more attacks in the manga, usually teaming up with Sailor Moon for double attacks. This is done once in the third movie when they perform Moon Gorgeous Meditation together.

In [[bishoujo senshi sailor moon crystal|Crystal]], she gains this form in the third season and performs Rainbow Double Moon Heart Ache alongside [[super sailor moon|super sailor moon]].
n: スーパーセーラーちびムーン

d: The super version of [[sailor jupiter|sailor jupiter]]. She gains a wreath of oak leaves that she wears in her hair, which she channels for [[jupiter oak evolution|jupiter oak evolution]]. She also still uses Sparkling Wide Pressure and [[supreme thunder|supreme thunder]] as required.
n: スーパーセーラーヴィーナス

d: The super version of [[sailor mars|sailor mars]]. She gains the Mars Arrow for the attack Mars Flame Sniper. She still uses uses Burning Mandala and Fire Soul as the situation requires. She also still uses her ofuda to banish evil spirits with the phrase, "Akuryou taisan!"
n: スーパーセーラーマーズ

d: The super form of [[sailor mercury|sailor mercury]]. She gains the [[mercury harp|mercury harp]] and uses the attack Mercury Aqua Rhapsody. She also uses Shine Aqua Illusion, but not Shabon Spray in the anime. For the special "Ami's First Love", she uses a one-time killer attack called Mercury Aqua Mirage.
n: スーパーセーラーマーキュリー

d:
One of [[sailor moon|sailor moon]]'s powered up forms, introduced in the third season to boost her finishing attack, while it remains her regular costume in the fourth arc.

Her fuku holds the basic design of Sailor Moon's original fuku, with some additional details such as sheer sleeves, heart brooch and belt buckle, hair accessories, and a large sheer back bow.
n: スーパーセーラームーン

d: The super form of [[sailor venus|sailor venus]]. She doesn't gain a special item like the other [[inner senshi|inner senshi]] do, but can use [[venus love and beauty shock|venus love and beauty shock]]. She can still use Crescent Beam and [[venus love me chain|venus love me chain]].
n: スーパーセーラーヴィーナス

d:
A form exclusive to the [[saiyan|saiyan]] race in [[dragon ball z|dragon ball z]] and onward. In order to go Super Saiyan for the first time, one must be either full-Saiyan or half-Saiyan. Early on, one must have gone through months or years of rigorous training, and have a pure heart or pure purpose. At first, one must've experienced something that would send them into a moment of ultimate rage, but over time that requirement was sidestepped.

On Danbooru, the tag indicates someone is going or already in Super Saiyan form, generally indicated by [[blonde hair|blonde]], [[spiked hair|spiked hair]], [[blue eyes|blue]] or [[green eyes|green eyes]], and a jagged, golden [[aura|aura]]. Due to its nature as an umbrella tag, it is also used for references to the form (even if only the aura is used). Additionally, it can also be used as a stand-in for indeterminate cases, especially those born out of the difficulty in differentiating between the original [[super saiyan 1|super saiyan 1]] form and [[super saiyan 2|super saiyan 2]].

A form of [[super saiyan|super saiyan]] that appears in the anime-only [[dragon ball gt|dragon ball gt]]. Born from gaining control over the [[golden oozaru|golden oozaru]] form, its main features are red fur covering the torso, longer hair, and red lining around the eyes. [[son goku|son goku]] is the first to achieve this form, followed by [[vegeta|vegeta]] and their fusion, [[gogeta|gogeta]] (whose Super Saiyan 4 form is different from his fusees, since his hair turns [[red hair|red]] and his body gains brown fur instead). It can be upgraded into [[super full power saiyan 4|super full power saiyan 4]].

[[dragon ball heroes|dragon ball heroes]] would later introduce a further evolution to this form, with the long name of [[super full power saiyan 4 limit breaker|super full power saiyan 4 limit breaker]].

Also known as **Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan**, it is a form of [[super saiyan|super saiyan]] achieved by those who have mastered divine energy, surpassing [[super saiyan god|super saiyan god]]. Appearance is identical to the [[super saiyan 1|first Super Saiyan form]], but features [[blue hair|blue hair]] and [[blue eyes|blue eyes]], as well as being a much calmer form internally.

There are many iterations of the character "Supergirl", but the most well-known and generally considered the "base" version is Kara Zor-El. She wears a female version of Superman's costume that usually gives her a [[skirt|skirt]] among other feminine alterations depending on her variation.

A popular and iconic superhero from [[dc comics|dc comics]], and the main character of the comic series [[superman (series)|of the same name]].

The humanoid [[alien|alien]] from Planet Krypton, sent to Earth as an infant child. His birth name is **Kal-El**, and his adoptive parents name him [[clark kent|clark kent]]. As living under a yellow sun grants Clark immense powers, such as hypersonic flight, nigh invulnerability, super strength, heat vision, a freezing breath, hypersensitive hearing, X-ray vision, and many others, he takes up the mantle of **Superman** - wearing a [[superhero costume|superhero costume]] that consists of a [[red cape|red cape]] and a [[blue bodysuit|blue]] [[bodysuit|suit]] - as he performs great heroic deeds around the Earth and in the city of Metropolis.

In many crossover media, Superman is frequently depicted as a rival of [[batman|batman]], primarily due to their contrasting qualities. Such as Superman's usage of superhuman power compared to Batman's usage of gadgets, and their clashing philosophies regarding how to handle a villain.

Superman was created by the late Joe Shuster and the late Jerry Siegel and was first introduced in *Action Comics* #1 (1938)

A firearm accessory designed to minimize audible report and [[muzzle flash|muzzle flash]]. A suppressor basically consists of a tube that may screw or latch onto the end of a gun barrel and is filled with baffles that allow air otherwise pushed out the front of the gun to slow down and expand.

Suppressors are sometimes known as "silencers," but this is an exaggeration of the abilities of a suppressor to lessen sound. As long as bullet travels at supersonic speeds, it will still create the distinctive "boom." However, it is possible to make a very quiet weapon using subsonic ammunition, eliminating the sonic boom and thus the major source of loudness for a weapon.

A [[mouth mask|mouth mask]] of the type worn by [[doctor|doctor]]s and [[nurse|nurse]]s to prevent the spread of bacteria from the wearer's mouth and nose.  It is composed of a rectangular piece of cloth with several horizontal folds to allow it to stretch over the mouth and nose.

This term refers to two similar types of medical masks, a *procedure mask* and *surgical mask*. Procedure masks may not be sterile and fasten by looping around the ears; used when carrying out general medical procedures like a check-up. Surgical masks are sterile and are fastened by bands that loop around the head; used when carrying out surgeries.

In Japan, it is common to wear a face mask whilst ill to avoid infecting others in public settings. During the [[coronavirus pandemic|coronavirus pandemic]], it became common to wear masks worldwide.

They are also worn by delinquents, from school renegades to [[bousouzoku|bousouzoku]] and the [[yakuza|yakuza]].

Suspenders or Galluses, known as Braces in British English, are elastic fabric straps worn over the shoulders to hold up trousers. The entire strap of braces may be elasticated, or only at attachment ends, with the most of the straps being of woven cloth with either a X-Back or Y-back crosspatch and leather end tabs. Braces typically attach to trousers with clips or, less commonly nowadays, with buttons. In British English the term suspenders or suspender belt refers to a [[garter belt|garter belt]], used to hold up [[thighhighs|stockings]].

The Disappearance of Suzumiya Haruhi

The fourth volume in the *[[suzumiya haruhi no yuuutsu|Suzumiya Haruhi]]* light novel series.

On October 8th, 2009, it was announced that it would be adapted into a feature film following the recently concluded second season. It premiered February 6th, 2010.

The manga *[[nagato yuki-chan no shoushitsu|nagato yuki-chan no shoushitsu]]*, with art by [[puyo (puyotopia)|puyo (puyotopia)]], is a spin-off based on the setting of this volume.

Suzumiya Haruhi no Yuuutsu (*The Melancholy of Suzumiya Haruhi*) is a light novel series by Tanigawa Nagaru, with art by [[ito noizi|ito noizi]], which was adapted into a 2006 anime by [[kyoto animation|kyoto animation]], along with a sequel in 2009, and a feature film, [[suzumiya haruhi no shoushitsu|suzumiya haruhi no shoushitsu]], in 2010. 

It has also been adapted into a number of videos games, drama CDs, and four official manga series. The first, with art by Mizuno Makoto, was considered a disservice and soon cancelled. The second, by Tsugano Gaku, has fared much better. The third is a spin-off based on [[suzumiya haruhi no shoushitsu|suzumiya haruhi no shoushitsu]], called [[nagato yuki-chan no shoushitsu|nagato yuki-chan no shoushitsu]], by [[puyo (puyotopia)|puyo (puyotopia)]]. The fourth is a parody manga, [[suzumiya haruhi-chan no yuuutsu|suzumiya haruhi-chan no yuuutsu]], also by [[puyo (puyotopia)|puyo (puyotopia)]], which saw a 2009 Original Net Animation adaptation by KyoAni.

*Nyoro~n Churuya-san*, by [[eretto|eretto]], is an unofficial doujinshi work, but was also given an ONA adaptation by KyoAni.

While mainly known as the *Suzumiya Haruhi* series, *Suzumiya Haruhi no Yuuutsu* refers to the first novel of the series, but is used for many of the adaptations, including the anime and manga.

Ancient religious symbol or [[mandala|mandala]] used in numerous cultures throughout history ([[india|india]], etc.). Takes the form of a [[cross|cross]] with four legs bent at 90 degrees.

The clockwise, or right-handed, swastika (卐) was appropriated by the [[nazi|Nazi Party]] as its emblem. This variant was turned 45 degrees in a white circle on a red background which is known as Hakenkreuz (hooked cross). The symbol continues to be widely associated with Nazism to the present day. 

Another user of the clockwise swastika was the [[finland|Finnish]] Air Force, which used a blue swastika for its aircraft insignia from 1918-1944. The [[latvia|Latvian]] Air Force used a dark red version.

The counterclockwise, or left-handed, swastika (卍) is an auspicious symbol in [[buddhism|buddhism]] known in Japan as *manji*.

The banner of the [[sweden|Kingdom of Sweden]].

The design of the flag is a heraldic-right-shifted (towards the flagpole) golden-yellow cross on a light middle-blue background. The exact dimensions of the flag are 4-2-4:5-2-9 for a total proportion of 10:16, which is number that approaches the golden ratio. Key things to take note of is that the blue fields towards the flagpole are *not* square and the thickness of the cross is half of the blue fields' height.

Legends say that Eric IX ("Eric the Holy") saw the golden cross in the sky when he landed in Finland during the first Swedish crusade in 1157. He took it as a sign from god and made it his flag. However, the legend doesn't match up to the historic usage of the flag nor is there evidence of such a crusade. More likely, the Swedish flag was created in resistance to Denmark -Sweden's arch-nemesis since ancient times- and took inspiration from their flag, [[danish flag|Dannebrogen]]. The blue and yellow were already commonly used as Swedish colours, for example in [[tre kronor|tre kronor]] which is the national [[coat of arms|coat of arms]].

There is a military variant of the flag which is significantly longer and has the end cut into three tongues. The proportions on this flag is 1:2. The tongues are cut from each field with the outer edges of the blue fields remaining straight and uncut. The length of the tongues is such that the uncut part of the flag has equally much blue on each side of the cross. The proportions are thus best described as 4-2-4:5-2-5-**8** where the last number is the tongues. This flag can have white 5-pointed stars in the upper right field to denote admiralty rank and are only used on navy vessels. Other versions exists with a white square on the centre of the cross. If the square extends outside the cross and has the coat of arms of Sweden, then it is the flag of the King and Queen. Other members of the royal family uses a variant with a smaller square that doesn't extend outside the cross and instead carry a different insignia on it.

In civilian usage the flag was almost exclusively used at sea. The biggest breakthrough towards flying the flag more was made on the 6th of June in 1916 when "Day of the Swedish Flag" was celebrated for the first time, a day which unofficially became Sweden's national holiday until it was officially recognized in 1983.

There are no strict laws governing the flying of the flag, except for the royal and military variants. Everyone is allowed to fly the flag whenever they want and for whatever reason that they find worth flying it for. However, there are several traditions and "unwritten rules" which are good customs to follow, the most important of which is to not fly the flag at night and to not fly the flag for no reason. The most common occasion that Swedes fly the flag for are birthdays and midsummer's eve. Swedish calendars also come with special "flag days" marked, which are good days to fly the flag on such as royal birthdays and historical anniversaries.

A 2009-current light novel series written by "Kawahara Reki":[https://twitter.com/kunori] and illustrated by [[bunbun|bunbun]]. It has multiple manga adaptations, multiple videogames, a three season anime, and three movies.

The series takes place in the near future and focuses on protagonist [[kirito|kirito]] and [[asuna (sao)|asuna (sao)]] as they play through various virtual reality MMORPG worlds.

Initially written in 2002 for the ASCII Media Works’ Dengeki Game Novel Prize (now Dengeki Novel Prize), the author refrained from sending it in due to exceeding the page limit.  Kawahara Reki published it as a web novel and later added 3 more volumes and short stories to the series.  After winning the Dengeki Novel Prize Grand Prize in 2008 for [[accel world|accel world]], ASCII Media Works requested that aside from Accel World if they could also publish Sword Art Online as well. The author agreed and withdrew the web novel version. The series was republished in light novel format in 2009.

The series received an anime adaptation in 2012, which later became highly successful. And went on popularize a whole subgenre of Japanese media known as [[isekai|isekai]], which involves having the main character(s) originated from modern world being reincarnated into other worlds.

A movie, [[sword art online the movie: ordinal scale|sword art online the movie: ordinal scale]], was released on February 18, 2017. The movie features a new original story that takes place some time after the second season of the anime.

A second movie, [[sword art online progressive|sword art online progressive]], was release on October 30, 2021. The movie retold the original story from the first two episodes of Aincrad Arc but through the perspective of [[asuna (sao)|asuna (sao)]].

**Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online** is a light novel spin-off series of [[sword art online|sword art online]] written by Shigusawa Keiichi, with supervision by Kawahara Reki, and illustrated by [[kuroboshi kouhaku|kuroboshi kouhaku]].  An anime adaptation aired Spring 2018 and a second season was announced in July of 2023.

The series is about Kohiruimaki Karen, a young college student who has a complex about her height of 183 cm (~72 in).  Enticed by the idea of being able to be someone else through a game avatar, Karen gets into Virtual Reality Massively Multiplayer Online Role Play Games (VRMMORPGs) wanting to be someone with a shorter stature.  She starts with ALfheim Online (ALO) using the name LLENN, but finds that the randomly assigned game avatar is too tall.  Advised by one of her friends, Karen transfers her account to various other games in the hopes of receiving a random avatar to her liking. She eventually settles on Gun Gale Online (GGO), as her randomly assigned avatar is a "chibi" with a height of 150 cm (~59 in).  The story starts after Karen becomes friends with an online player named Pitohui, who gets Karen to participate in a team-based tournament called Squad Jam.

The **T-34** was a [[soviet|soviet]] medium [[tank|tank]] that had a profound and lasting effect on the field of tank design as it spawned the concept of what is nowadays known as modern Main Battle Tanks or MBTs.

Although its armour and armament were surpassed later in the war, it has been often credited as the most effective, efficient, and influential tank design of [[world war ii|world war ii]] due to its multiple innovations. More than 80,000 T-34s and its variants were produced by the Soviet Union during WWII, making it the **most produced tank** of the whole war. Because of this some experts have even declared that the T-34 is **the tank that saved the Soviet Union**.

At its introduction, the T-34 possessed an unprecedented combination of firepower, mobility, speed, protection, and ruggedness. Its 76.2 mm (3 in) high-velocity tank gun provided a substantial increase in firepower over any of its contemporaries; its heavy sloped armor was difficult to penetrate by most contemporary anti-tank weapons. Its engine was small and efficient, also providing very high speed and a long autonomy and range. However, this come at the cost of atrocious crew ergonomics as the crew of four (later five in the late [[t-34-85|t-34-85]] variant) were tightly packed in frontal compartment.

A kind of traditional Japanese [[socks|sock]]. Modern tabi resemble regular socks, only there is a division between the big toe and the other toes, and the soles are usually thicker. Historically, Tabi are commonly made of inelastic materials such as [[leather|leather]] and cotton and have fasteners at the back due to its origin as indoor footwear, but modern Tabi also use stretchable fabrics. For socks with division between all toes use [[toe socks|toe socks]] instead. 

For tabi that are used as footwear, use [[jika-tabi|jika-tabi]] instead.

A tablet computer, commonly just called a tablet, is a portable [[computer|computer]] housed within the casing of a handheld touchscreen display.  They appear like a larger version of the modern [[smartphone|smartphone]].

Unlike [[laptop|laptops]], tablet computers lack a built-in [[computer keyboard|keyboard]].  Should not be confused with a 2-in-1 laptop, which is a laptop that features a touchscreen with the ability to flip or rotate so the display can conceal the laptop keyboard.

A popular example of a tablet computer is the [[ipad|ipad]].

Should not be confused with a [[drawing tablet|drawing tablet]], which is a computer input device that enables a user to hand-draw images on a computer.
